figure.caption: Illurstation of SelfExtend. This figure shows the attention score matrix (before SoftMax operation) of SelfExtend while a sequence of length $10$ is fed into an LLM with the pretraining context window size ( $L=7$ ). The numbers denote the relative distances between the corresponding query and key tokens. SelfExtend has two kinds of attention mechanism: for neighbor tokens within the neighbor window ( $w_{n}=4$ ), it adapts the normal self-attention; for tokens out of the window, it adapts the values from the grouped attention. figure.caption: (a) Illustration of the StableMask mechanism. (b) StableMask integrates with the softmax operation, replacing the traditional causal mask. (c) The attention score matrix is first cleared of attention values in the upper triangular part using the $C$ matrix, then pseudo-attention scores are added using the $P$ matrix followed by the softmax computation. (d) After the softmax operation, the remaining attention probabilities in the upper triangular part are cleared using $C$ to ensure the causal decoding property. (e) The $C$ matrix has zeros in the upper triangular part and ones in the lower triangular part, while the $P$ matrix has linear decay in the upper triangular part and zeros in the lower triangular part. $\gamma$ is a hyperparameter. (f) StableMask for inference. An input sequence needs a suffix.

en.title: StableMask: Refining Causal Masking in Decoder-only Transformer
en.mechanism: StableMask lets attention leave some of its weight unused. It puts decaying pseudo-scores into the softmax and masks those entries out afterward, so real tokens need not absorb all the mass.

figure.caption: Illustration of StreamingLLM vs. existing methods. The language model, pre-trained on texts of length $L$, predicts the $T$ th token ( $T\gg L$ ). (a) Dense Attention has $O(T^{2})$ time complexity and an increasing cache size. Its performance decreases when the text length exceeds the pre-training text length. (b) Window Attention caches the most recent $L$ tokens’ KV. While efficient in inference, performance declines sharply once the starting tokens’ keys and values are evicted. (c) Sliding Window with Re-computation rebuilds the KV states from the $L$ recent tokens for each new token. While it performs well on long texts, its $O(TL^{2})$ complexity, stemming from quadratic attention in context re-computation, makes it considerably slow. (d) StreamingLLM keeps the attention sink (several initial tokens) for stable attention computation, combined with the recent tokens. It’s efficient and offers stable performance on extended texts. Perplexities are measured using the Llama-2-13B model on the first book (65K tokens) in the PG-19 test set.

figure.caption: We provide an illustration of the TimesFM model architecture during training, where we show a input time-series of a specific length that can be broken down into input patches. Each patch along is processed into a vector by a residual block (as defined in the model definition) to the model dimension of the transformer layers. The vector is then added to positional encodings and fed into $n_{l}$ stacked transformer layers. SA refers to self-attention (note that we use multi-head causal attention) and FFN is the fully connected layer in the transformer. The output tokens are then mapped through a residual block to an output of size output_patch_len, which is the forecast for the time window following the last input patch seen by the model so far.

figure.caption: TokenFlow pipeline. Top: Given an input video $\cal{I}$, we DDIM invert each frame, extract its tokens, i.e., output features from the self-attention modules, from each timestep and layer, and compute inter-frame features correspondences using a nearest-neighbor (NN) search. Bottom: The edited video is generated as follows: at each denoising step $t$, (I) we sample keyframes from the noisy video $J_{t}$ and jointly edit them using an extended-attention block; the set of resulting edited tokens is $\mathbf{T}_{base}$. (II) We propagate the edited tokens across the video according to the pre-computed correspondences of the original video features. To denoise $J_{t}$, we feed each frame to the network, and replace the generated tokens with the tokens obtained from the propagation step (II).

figure.caption: Schematic representation of an mLSTM block – pre up-projection: Embedded in a pre-LayerNorm residual structure, the input is up-projected first with projection factor 2, once for an externalized output gate and once as input for the mLSTM cells. The mLSTM cell input is dimension-wise causally convoluted (kernel size 4), before entering a learnable skip connection. We obtain input $q$ and $k$ via block-diagonal projection matrices of block size 4. The values $v$ are fed directly, skipping the convolution part. After the mLSTM sequence mixing, outputs are normalized via GroupNorm [(Wu & He, 2018)] – a head-wise layer norm for each of the four heads. Finally, the learnable skip input is added and the result is gated component-wise with the external output gate. The output is down-projected.

figure.caption: The Zamba architecture. Zamba consists of a backbone of standard Mamba blocks connected to a shared attention and MLP block. This block is repeated every 6 Mamba blocks but has shared parameters, which enables Mamba to utilize more FLOPs for increased performance at the same memory cost. The input embeddings are always concatenated with the residual stream going into the shared attention block as this provides an additional path for the model to remember the inputs. After the block, a learnt linear projection maps the output back to the residual stream.

figure.caption: The complete Chronos-2 pipeline. Input time series (targets and covariates) are first normalized using a robust scaling scheme, after which time index and mask meta features are added. The resulting sequences are split into non-overlapping patches and mapped to high-dimensional embeddings via a residual network. The core transformer stack operates on these patch embeddings and produces multi-patch quantile outputs corresponding to the masked future patches provided as input. Each transformer block alternates between time and group attention layers: the time attention layer aggregates information across patches within a single time series, while the group attention layer aggregates information across all series within a group at each patch index. A group is a flexible notion of relatedness and may correspond to a single time series, multiple series sharing a source or metadata, variates of a multivariate series, or targets along with associated covariates. The figure illustrates two multivariate time series with one known covariate each, with corresponding groups highlighted in blue and red. This example is for illustration only; Chronos-2 supports arbitrary numbers of targets and optional covariates.

figure.caption: Method Overview. Our method performs online dense 3D reconstruction from a stream of images (video frames or a photo collection) by using a persistent state. Each input image is encoded into visual tokens via a shared-weight ViT encoder. These tokens interact with state tokens, where state update integrates the current image into the state, and state readout retrieves the past context stored in the state for predictions. Both processes occur simultaneously through two interconnected ViT decoders. Outputs include pointmaps in world and camera frames (only world pointmaps are shown) and the camera-to-world transformation. On the right, we demonstrate our method’s ability to predict unseen views: given a query camera (as a raymap), it reads information from the state to predict its corresponding pointmap, even for unobserved regions. For these readouts, we do not update the state. The hallucinated pointmap is highlighted with a blue border.

en.title: Continuous 3D Perception Model with Persistent State
en.mechanism: CUT3R maintains scene tokens as images arrive. Cross-attention lets each new image read the stored scene for its 3D prediction, and lets the scene state absorb information from that image.

exhibits.mechanism: 生成时改用稀疏注意力，读出的特征会偏离全量计算。Delta Attention 在少数锚点上算稠密与稀疏结果的差，再给附近位置加上这项修正。
exhibits.license_note: 仓库根目录未见明确许可

figure.caption: Overview of $\mathbf{\Delta}$ Attention. (Top) Given an arbitrary sparse attention method we calculate the difference between the sparse attention and full attention for a small subset of queries. The subset size is controlled by a hyperparameter $\gamma$. (Bottom) We then repeat the calculated difference for all output tokens and add the result to the full sparse attention output. The result is an approximation to the original quadratic attention.

en.title: Delta Attention: Fast and Accurate Sparse Attention Inference by Delta Correction
en.mechanism: Switching to sparse attention at decoding can shift its outputs. Delta Attention measures the dense-minus-sparse difference at selected anchors and adds those corrections to nearby sparse outputs.

figure.caption: DepthSplat connects depth estimation and 3D Gaussian splatting with a shared architecture, which enables cross-task transfer. In particular, DepthSplat consists of a multi-view branch to model feature-matching information and a single-view branch to extract monocular features. The per-view cost volumes and monocular features are concatenated for depth regression with a 2D U-Net architecture. For the depth estimation task, we train the depth model with ground truth depth supervision. For the Gaussian splatting task, we first unproject all depth maps to 3D as the Gaussian centers, and in parallel, we use an additional head to predict the remaining Gaussian parameters. Novel views are rendered with the splatting operation. The full model for novel view synthesis is trained with the photometric rendering loss, which can also be used as an unsupervised pre-training stage for the depth model.

en.title: DepthSplat: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth
en.mechanism: DepthSplat exchanges features across nearby views and builds a stereo cost volume. Where matching is difficult, pretrained single-image depth features supply additional evidence for placing the 3D Gaussians.

figure.caption: Overview of DuoAttention: (1) In the retrieval head identification phase, we assign a trainable gate value, $\alpha$, to each attention head, which blends the outputs of full attention and streaming attention. The training objective is to optimize these values to minimize the deviation from the full attention model’s output, while simultaneously applying a regularization loss to encourage lower gate values. This training phase is efficient, requiring only the gate values to be trainable—leaving all other model parameters frozen—thus allowing it to be completed within several hours on an 8 GPU node. (2) During deployment, these gate values are binarized to classify heads as either retrieval or streaming based on a threshold $\tau$. Retrieval heads, identified by a gate value above the threshold, use full attention, caching the KV pairs for all tokens. In contrast, streaming heads cache only the KV pairs of recent tokens and attention sinks.

en.title: DuoAttention: Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference with Retrieval and Streaming Heads
en.authors: Guangxuan Xiao, Jiaming Tang, Jingwei Zuo, Junxian Guo, Shang Yang, Haotian Tang, Yao Fu, Song Han
en.mechanism: DuoAttention gives full cache access to the heads that retrieve distant tokens. Streaming heads keep only a bounded cache of initial and recent tokens, reducing the amount of history stored.
en.verification: No numerical comparison was performed. The caches matched exactly, and the maximum absolute output difference was 1.78813934e-07.

figure.caption: Illustration of Frequency Dynamic Attention Modulation (FDAM), comprising AttInv for attention modulation and FreqScale for feature modulation. The original attention mechanism is predominantly influenced by low-frequency components due to its inherent low-pass filtering characteristics. i) AttInv inverts the low-pass filter, represented by the attention weights, to derive a high-pass filter. By dynamically combining these filters using a predicted weight, we achieve a balanced representation that retains both low- and high-frequency information. ii) FreqScale adaptively reweights different frequency bands, enhancing suppressed high-frequency components ( e.g., edges, textures) while preserving structural low-frequency information. This integrated approach alleviates attention collapse and patch uniformity issues in Vision Transformers, facilitating full-spectrum feature representation for improved discriminability.

en.mechanism: Repeated attention can wash out fine detail. FDAM constructs a high-pass counterpart to attention's low-pass response and adjusts the balance of those frequency components for the input.

figure.caption: The reasons why RoPE’s periodic extension deteriorates and how FoPE addresses these issues to improve length generalization. (a) As signals pass through linear and nonlinear transformations, this causes spectral leakage and distortion, mixing multiple frequencies into a single dimension. Under RoPE, each dimension is treated as a single-frequency component. By contrast, FoPE models each dimension as a Fourier series of different frequency components, thereby separating information more effectively and mitigating spectral damage. (b) FoPE eliminates inadequately trained frequency components, which are harmful for periodic extension. By preserving only the zero-frequency component, FoPE safeguards periodic extension and delivers more robust length generalization.

en.title: Fourier Position Embedding: Enhancing Attention's Periodic Extension for Length Generalization
en.mechanism: FoPE treats position encoding as a Fourier series. It removes components that are poorly supported by the training span, helping the attention pattern extend to longer sequences.

figure.caption: HART is an efficient hybrid autoregressive image generation framework. It decomposes continuous image tokens into two components: 1) a series of discrete tokens modeled by a scalable-resolution (up to 1024px) autoregressive transformer, and 2) residual tokens modeled by a lightweight residual diffusion (37M parameters and 8 steps) module. figure.caption: The SAM 2 architecture. For a given frame, the segmentation prediction is conditioned on the current prompt and/or on previously observed memories. Videos are processed in a streaming fashion with frames being consumed one at a time by the image encoder, and cross-attended to memories of the target object from previous frames. The mask decoder, which optionally also takes input prompts, predicts the segmentation mask for that frame. Finally, a memory encoder transforms the prediction and image encoder embeddings (not shown in the figure) for use in future frames.

figure.caption: Overview of InfiniteHiP. (a) Infinitely growing KV cache: In InfiniteHiP, the context keys and values are stored in a unified memory space, where some of the keys and values are loaded on GPU memory. (b) Configurable modular pruning: Each pruning stage narrows down the candidate key indices based on the current query block. During pruning, if a cache miss is encountered, the missing tokens are dynamically loaded and the GPU cache is updated. (c) Paged block sparse attention: The selected key indices are used to perform efficient paged block sparse attention.

en.title: InfiniteHiP: Extending Language Model Context Up to 3 Million Tokens on a Single GPU
en.mechanism: InfiniteHiP searches a long context in stages. It prunes groups of irrelevant tokens before refining the search, so the final attention pass can focus on a smaller set of positions.

en.mechanism: LWGA gives separate channel groups different fields of view. Their point, local, medium-range, and global features are combined to represent both tiny objects and broad terrain.

exhibits.title: Multiscale Sparse Cross-Attention Network for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感场景的各组通道可能各自藏着不同的分类线索。M-CBAM 先在组内估计通道和空间权重，再重调这些权重，突出有用的局部特征。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/多组空间通道注意力（M-CBAM）

figure.caption: Each group builds a channel-and-spatial mask, promotes above-mean entries to one, then the combined mask scales the features before residual addition.
figure.caption_zh: 每组依次做通道和空间加权。掩码中高于组内均值的值置为 1，再拼接掩码、缩放特征并加残差。

en.title: Multiscale Sparse Cross-Attention Network for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
en.mechanism: Grouped CBAM lets subsets of features find different salient regions. The enhancer readjusts their channel and spatial weights before the scene classifier uses them.

exhibits.name_zh: 局部敏感哈希采样注意力
exhibits.title: MagicPIG: LSH Sampling for Efficient LLM Generation
exhibits.mechanism: 只取最高分的历史词，可能漏掉许多低分项合起来的贡献。MagicPIG 用局部敏感哈希抽样取键值，再按入样概率补偿各样本的权重。

copies.path: 论文复现/自然语言处理/局部敏感哈希采样注意力（MagicPIG）

figure.caption: Left: Memory hierarchy of hardware. GPU VRAM has high bandwidth but is limited. CPU DRAM is sufficient but is relatively slow. The limited bandwidth of PCIE forbids large-scale data transfer. Right: Workload partition of MagicPIG. Linear projections and hash function computation (by random projection) are done on GPU, while sampling with hash tables and attention are done on CPU. The execution order is $\textcircled{1}\textcircled{3}\textcircled{4}\textcircled{2}$ at decoding time.

en.title: MagicPIG: LSH Sampling for Efficient LLM Generation
en.mechanism: Many modest scores can still add up to important context. MagicPIG samples cache entries with locality-sensitive hashing and corrects their weights for the chance that each entry was sampled.
en.verification: No numerical comparison was performed (the original entry point imported a legacy LLaMA class removed from the current Transformers, and prefill was limited to CUDA Efficient Attention). The same state_dict, hash matrices, and random input were used to compare batch execution with running the original class one item at a time.

exhibits.title: Rectifying Magnitude Neglect in Linear Attention
exhibits.mechanism: 普通线性注意力里，查询放大后分数分布几乎不变。MALA 把查询的幅度带回打分，让强查询可以把更多权重集中在少数键上。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/幅度感知线性注意力（MALA）

figure.caption: Positive queries and keys provide a magnitude correction for rotary linear attention, then a local value term and output gate refine the result.
figure.caption_zh: 正值查询和键为旋转线性注意力提供幅度修正。模块再加入值的局部项，使用输出门控并投影。

en.title: Rectifying Magnitude Neglect in Linear Attention
en.mechanism: Normalized linear attention can discard the magnitude of a query. MALA restores that information so stronger queries can concentrate more weight on their best matches.

exhibits.title: Linear Attention with Global Context A Multipole Attention Mechanism for Vision and Physic
exhibits.mechanism: 高分辨率网格上，全量注意力很贵，先把整图缩小又会丢掉细节。MANO 按距离分尺度，近处用细网格，远处用聚合后的粗网格，每个头仍能看全局。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/多极注意力（MANO）

figure.caption: Shared patch attention processes each resolution, then the module upsamples and adds coarse responses back into finer maps.
figure.caption_zh: 各分辨率共用图块注意力。模块从粗到细上采样，把粗尺度响应逐级加到细尺度特征中。

en.title: Linear Attention with Global Context A Multipole Attention Mechanism for Vision and Physic
en.mechanism: MANO borrows the multiscale logic of particle simulation. Attention reads nearby grid points in detail and groups distant points into coarser summaries, giving each head global reach at a linear cost.

exhibits.title: MaskAttn-UNet A Mask Attention-Driven Framework for Universal Low-Resolution Image Segment
exhibits.mechanism: 低分辨率图里，无关背景会挤占注意力。MaskAttn 在多头自注意力的点积分数上加一张可学习的空间掩码，再做 softmax，降低背景位置的权重。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/掩码注意力（MaskAttn）

figure.caption: A cached binary key mask blocks scores before softmax, then the weighted values pass through a token residual and layer normalization.
figure.caption_zh: 缓存的二值键掩码先屏蔽部分分数。值经 Softmax 加权后，模块加回令牌残差并做层归一化。

en.title: MaskAttn-UNet A Mask Attention-Driven Framework for Universal Low-Resolution Image Segment
en.mechanism: MaskAttn adds a learned mask to the self-attention logits before softmax. At each U-Net scale, the mask helps the segmenter devote less weight to uninformative locations.

exhibits.title: Rahman MK-UNet Multi-kernel Lightweight CNN for Medical Image Segmentation ICCVW 2025 pape
exhibits.mechanism: 医学图像里的目标大小差异很大。MKIRA 先用通道和空间门筛选特征，再在倒置残差块里用多种大小的逐通道卷积补上不同范围的线索。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/多核倒置残差注意力（MKIRA）

figure.caption: Channel and spatial gates precede multikernel depthwise filtering, whose branches are combined, shuffled, and projected through an optional residual.
figure.caption_zh: 模块先做通道和空间加权，再用多个深度卷积核提取特征。各路合并并打乱通道，投影后可加残差。

en.title: Rahman MK-UNet Multi-kernel Lightweight CNN for Medical Image Segmentation ICCVW 2025 pape
en.mechanism: MKIRA gates decoder features across channels and spatial positions before passing them to an inverted residual block. Several depthwise kernel sizes let that block gather cues from different neighborhoods.

exhibits.title: Exploring Multimodal Diffusion Transformers for Enhanced Prompt-based Image Editing

queue.note: 按联合注意力图选择适合编辑的层和位置。局部编辑时分开处理前景和背景。 官方固定提交的文件树、README 与作者修改的处理器未声明再分发许可。已转入论文复现队列。

en.title: Exploring Multimodal Diffusion Transformers for Enhanced Prompt-based Image Editing
en.mechanism: For prompt edits in MMDiT, the method copies only the source image queries and keys during early denoising. A selected text-image attention block supplies spatial evidence for a mask when the edit should stay local.

exhibits.title: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
exhibits.authors: Enzhe Lu、Zhejun Jiang、Jingyuan Liu、Yulun Du、Tao Jiang、Chao Hong、Shaowei Liu、Weiran He、Enming Yuan、Yuzhi Wang、Zhiqi Huang、Huan Yuan、Suting Xu、Xinran Xu、Guokun Lai、Yanru Chen、Huabin Zheng、Junjie Yan、Jianlin Su、Yuxin Wu、Neo Y. Zhang、Zhilin Yang、Xinyu Zhou、Mingxing Zhang、Jiezhong Qiu
exhibits.mechanism: 长文里，同一个查询需要的上下文往往分散在几段。MoBA 先用每块的平均键给块打分，再对入选块中的 token 做注意力。

exhibits.title: mPLUG-Owl3: Towards Long Image-Sequence Understanding in Multi-Modal Large Language Models
exhibits.mechanism: 许多图插进长文本时，每层都混在一起算会很重。mPLUG-Owl3 并行算文字自注意力和图文交叉注意力，再用文字生成的门混合两种读出。

en.title: mPLUG-Owl3: Towards Long Image-Sequence Understanding in Multi-Modal Large Language Models
en.mechanism: In mPLUG-Owl3, selected layers let text attend to images in parallel with text self-attention. A gate computed from the text features decides how much visual information to mix in.
en.verification: No numerical comparison was performed by directly importing the original official file. The maximum absolute difference for the output tensors in the test was 0.0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

exhibits.title: Mr. DETR: Instructive Multi-Route Training for Detection Transformers
exhibits.mechanism: 检测器的一对一匹配给每个目标分到的正样本少。Mr. DETR 在一对多训练支路里加可学习的指令令牌，让物体查询在自注意力中读取它。

en.title: Mr. DETR: Instructive Multi-Route Training for Detection Transformers
en.mechanism: Mr. DETR trains its decoder on both one-to-one and one-to-many assignments. An auxiliary self-attention route adds learned instruction tokens that steer queries toward the one-to-many task.

exhibits.title: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network Based on Self-Attention Mechanism and State Sp
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感图里有大块地物，也有窄路和小建筑。MSAM 在不同尺度上算自注意力，再把读到的特征合并，让分割能参考不同范围。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/多尺度自注意力模块（MSAM）

figure.caption: Four aligned scale maps feed ten self and cross-scale pairs, whose row-wise channel attention is fused and added to a convolutional merge.
figure.caption_zh: 四路对齐的尺度图组成十对。模块对每一对逐行做通道注意力，再融合结果并加上卷积融合分支。

en.title: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network Based on Self-Attention Mechanism and State Sp
en.mechanism: Objects in aerial images occupy very different scales. MSAM combines self-attention features computed at multiple scales so segmentation can use context at more than one resolution.

exhibits.name_zh: 多尺度稀疏交叉注意力
exhibits.title: Multiscale Sparse Cross-Attention Network for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感场景分类时，浅层纹理有用，也容易带进杂讯。MSC 用深层特征分别查询各尺度的浅层特征，稀疏注意力在融合前筛掉低相关响应。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/多尺度稀疏交叉注意力（MSC）
copies.name_zh: 多尺度稀疏交叉注意力

figure.caption_zh: 上下文经过多尺度池化后提供键和值。两种稀疏掩码分别加权值，结果用可学习系数相加。

en.title: Multiscale Sparse Cross-Attention Network for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
en.mechanism: MSC lets high-level scene features query several shallower scales separately. Sparse cross-attention suppresses weak matches, so fine texture can inform the scene label without overwhelming it.

exhibits.title: MSLAU-Net A Hybird CNN-Transformer Network for Medical Image Segmentation
exhibits.mechanism: 分割时，局部病灶和远处上下文都要看。MSLA 先用不同大小的卷积提取词元，再分别沿查询行和键列归一化，先乘键和值以省去两两分数。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/多尺度线性注意力（MSLA）

figure.caption: Four channel groups use different depthwise kernels and one shared linear attention, then learned scale weights combine their outputs through a pointwise projection.
figure.caption_zh: 四组通道各用不同深度卷积核，共用同一个线性注意力。各路乘以可学习系数后拼接，再做逐点投影。

en.title: MSLAU-Net A Hybird CNN-Transformer Network for Medical Image Segmentation
en.mechanism: MSLA takes tokens from convolution branches at several scales. Separate softmax operations on queries and keys let each branch combine keys with values before the query reads the result.

exhibits.title: Rethinking Transformer-Based Blind-Spot Network for Self-Supervised Image Denoising
exhibits.mechanism: 自监督去噪若偷看到待预测的像素，就容易把噪声也抄下来。MWSA 用窗口掩码约束注意力可读的位置，让范围照着空洞卷积排布。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/掩码窗口自注意力（MWSA）

figure.caption: Illustration of receptive field. (a) Original window attention performs all-to-all interactions between query and key/value. (b) Our M-WSA applies an elaborate mask to the attention matrix (see Fig. 2 (d)), so the blue pixels of query only attend to the locations of key/value at even coordinates, which mimics the receptive field of dilated convolutions.

en.title: Rethinking Transformer-Based Blind-Spot Network for Self-Supervised Image Denoising
en.mechanism: A blind-spot denoiser must predict a pixel without seeing it. MWSA masks window attention to follow the receptive field of a dilated convolution, blocking paths that would reveal the target pixel.

exhibits.title: Pay Attention to Your Neighbours: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
exhibits.mechanism: CLIP 分割时，远处相似的块可能抢走局部注意力。NACLIP 用键与键的相似度打分，再按图像块之间的距离加高斯偏置，给邻近块更多权重。

figure.caption: Schematic figure depicting the mechanism to form attention maps. Maps are shown for the patch located at $\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\bigstar$, $\omega({\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\bigstar})$ denotes a discretized Gaussian kernel centered at $\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\bigstar$ (see Eq. 11 ), and $[{\mathbf{x}\mathbf{y}^{\top}}]_{\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\bigstar}$ indexes $\mathbf{x}\mathbf{y}^{\top}$ on patch $\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\bigstar$. CLIP does not ensure high attention to the patch itself and the neighbouring patches, while NACLIP does. Scaling and $\mathrm{softmax}$ operations are omitted for demonstration simplicity.

en.title: Pay Attention to Your Neighbours: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
en.mechanism: NACLIP compares keys with keys in CLIP's last attention layer. A Gaussian bias boosts patches near each location, where the context is more useful for drawing a segmentation mask.

exhibits.title: nGPT: Normalized Transformer with Representation Learning on the Hypersphere

figure.caption: Palu uses low-rank decomposition $(\mathbf{W}\approx\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B})$ to project the key (or value) to a lower-dimensional latent representation $(\mathbf{h})$, thereby reducing the size of the KV-Cache. The original key $(\mathbf{K}_{t})$ is reconstructed on-the-fly with $\mathbf{B}^{k}$, and $\mathbf{B}^{v}$ is fused into $\mathbf{W}^{o}$ to avoid reconstruction overhead. The fusion also reduces the computational burden for output projection.

exhibits.mechanism: 核映射把负分量压掉后，会漏掉查询和键的异号关系。PolaFormer 分别算同号与异号交互，再用可学习的幂函数拉开强弱分数。

figure.caption: The overall framework of PolaFormer. Our framework explicitly separates query-key pairs based on their polarity into two distinct streams, with scaled outputs controlled by the learnable sign-aware matrices $\mathbf{G}^{s}$ and $\mathbf{G}^{o}$ for same-signed and opposite-signed components, respectively. A channel-wise power function with the learnable exponent $\mathbf{p}$ is employed to learn the rescaling process, capturing the sharpness characteristic of softmax.

en.title: PolarFormer: Polarity-aware Linear Attention for Vision Transformers
en.mechanism: Nonnegative feature maps can lose information from negative query and key components. PolaFormer models matching and opposing signs separately, then uses learned powers to sharpen the attention weights.

figure.caption: Overview of our RandAR. (a) Conventional autoregressive generation typically enforces a fixed order, e.g., raster order, allowing the model to memorize token orders. (b) Our RandAR enables random order generation by inserting a position instruction token before each image token to be predicted. This design seamlessly integrates with the next-token prediction framework using decoder-only transformer.

en.title: RandAR: Decoder-only Autoregressive Visual Generation in Random Orders
en.mechanism: RandAR puts a position instruction before each image token it predicts. The causal decoder can then use previously generated tokens even when it fills locations in an arbitrary order.

exhibits.mechanism: 按行画图，每个位置能读到的邻居就固定了。RAR 在训练早期打乱令牌顺序，因果注意力仍只读排在前面的令牌，再逐步回到固定的扫描顺序。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像生成与编辑/随机顺序因果注意力（RAR Random-Order Attention）

figure.caption: Overview of the proposed Randomized AutoRegressive (RAR) model, which is fully compatible with language modeling frameworks. Left : RAR introduces a randomness annealing training strategy to enhance the model’s ability to learn bidirectional contexts. During training, the input sequence is randomly permuted with a probability $r$, which starts at 1 (fully random permutations) and linearly decreases to 0, transitioning the model to a fixed scan order, such as raster scan, by the end of training. Right : Randomly selected images generated by RAR, trained on ImageNet.

en.title: Randomized Autoregressive Visual Generation
en.mechanism: RAR trains the same causal Transformer on many pixel-token orders before settling on a fixed scan order. The mask still follows the current sequence, so context can come from different sides of a patch during training.

figure.caption: Diagram outlining how our method operates during inference to retrieve the most relevant keys when a new input query is received. Refer to Section 3.2 for 1-level retrieval and Section 3.3 for hierarchical retrieval. For 1-level retrieval, the query token is first compared against the representative centroid of each cluster to identify the most relevant clusters. Exact attention is then computed only for the keys within these retrieved clusters, rather than across the entire fixed context. In our hierarchical retrieval approach (Section 3.3, demonstrating a 2-level hierarchy for clarity), we first compare the query with coarse-grained Level 1 centroids, and then only compare with a subset of the promising fine-grained Level 2 centroids in order to identify the important keys.

figure.caption: Overview of SVG2. * * * Cross-category centroids arise from SVG2’s independent clustering, which enables a many-to-many map where multiple query clusters share important key clusters. figure.caption: Memory as a Context (MAC) Architecture. This architecture includes three branches of (1) core, (2) contextual (long-term) memory, and (3) persistent memory. The core branch concatenates the corresponding long-term and persistent memories with the input sequence. Next, attention performs on the sequence and decides what part of the information should store in the long-term memory. At the test time, parameters corresponds to contextual memory are still learning, parameters corresponds to the core branch are responsible for in-context learning, and parameters of persistent memory are responsible to store the knowledge about tasks and so are fixed.

figure.caption: Overview of the Toto architecture, highlighting our novel components in bold. \tiny\textbf{A}⃝ Multivariate input time series of $L$ steps are scaled using causal patch-based instance normalization, transformed into patch embeddings, and passed through a decoder-only transformer stack. The transformed features are unembedded and passed through a Student-T mixture model (optimized via a composite robust loss ) which generates probabilistic next-patch predictions. \tiny\textbf{B}⃝ The patch embedding takes as input a time series of $M$ variates by $L$ time steps. It divides the time dimension into patches of size $P=64$ and projects these linearly into an embedding space of latent dimension $D=768$. This results in an output of size $M\times\frac{L}{P}\times D$ which is fed to the transformer decoder. \tiny\textbf{C}⃝ The transformer stack features proportional factorized attention. It contains $F=1$ identical segment(s), with $N=11$ time-wise transformer blocks followed by one variate-wise block.

figure.caption: One layer $\ell$ of the proposed Token Statistics Transformer ( ToST ). Notably, the self-attention of ToST transforms tokens $\mathbf{Z}^{\ell}$ efficiently to $\mathbf{Z}^{\ell+1}$, via multiplying each row of the projected token by only a scalar. figure.caption: Framework of VisionZip. VisionZip selects dominant tokens that aggregate substantial information based on visual token attention scores. Remaining tokens are merged based on semantic similarity to produce contextual tokens. figure.caption: Illustration of XAttention: XAttention optimizes attention through a three-step process: (Left) Strided Antidiagonal Scoring: Each block (8 $\times$ 8 in this example) is scored by summing values along its strided antidiagonals (stride = 4), with red lines generally indicating higher summed values and blue lines lower values. (Middle) Block Selection: High-scoring blocks are selected based on these evaluations. (Right) Block Sparse Attention: Attention is computed only on the selected blocks (red blocks on the right), achieving substantial computational savings. This example uses a sequence length of 24.

en.title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
en.mechanism: XAttention estimates how much a score block matters by summing entries along its antidiagonal. It runs full attention on the selected blocks, avoiding the cost of scoring every block densely.

figure.caption: Scaled signs replace queries and keys before scoring, then optional eight-bit quantization prepares the probabilities and values for mixing.
figure.caption_zh: 模块用带缩放的二值符号替换查询与键再打分，混合前可将概率和值量化为八位。

en.title: BinaryAttention One-Bit QK-Attention for Vision and Diffusion Transformers(1)
en.mechanism: BinaryAttention scores queries and keys using only their signs. Bitwise comparisons replace floating-point dot products, and a learned bias compensates for information lost in binarization.

exhibits.title: Implicit Optical Flow-Guided Network for Infrared Small-Target Tracking
exhibits.mechanism: 低对比度下，小目标容易和背景混在一起。BSA 把特征图切成相互重叠的块，只在每块内部算多头自注意力，保留边缘附近的信息。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视频与动作理解/分块自注意力（BSA）

figure.caption: One channel half bypasses two patch attention blocks, whose overlapping outputs average back onto the grid before channel fusion.
figure.caption_zh: 一半通道走捷径，另一半经过两个块内注意力单元，重叠区取平均后再与捷径融合。

en.title: Implicit Optical Flow-Guided Network for Infrared Small-Target Tracking
en.mechanism: BSA divides a low-contrast infrared feature map into overlapping patches. Multi-head self-attention runs independently within each patch, retaining local context around patch boundaries.

exhibits.authors: Chung-Shien Brian Wang、Christian Schmidt、Jens Piekenbrinck、Bastian Leibe

exhibits.mechanism: 多视图重建里，多数图块之间没有几何对应。BSGA 先池化查询和键来估计块间匹配度，再只对得分高的块计算细粒度注意力。

figure.caption: Architecture overview of VGGT [41]. The key component is the Aggregator consisting of $L=24$ alternating attention blocks (first frame-wise attention, then global attention over all frames). Each input frame is augmented with five learned embedding vectors: one camera token and four register tokens. After the Aggregator, VGGT regresses camera poses from the camera tokens using a light-weight MLP head, and dense outputs (point maps, depth, point tracks) using DPT heads [29].

en.title: Block-Sparse Global Attention for Efficient Multi-View Geometry Transformers
en.authors: Chung-Shien Brian Wang, Christian Schmidt, Jens Piekenbrinck, Bastian Leibe
en.mechanism: BSGA uses pooled queries and keys to find promising blocks of cross-view patch matches. Those blocks receive full attention, while most patch pairs are skipped during 3D reconstruction.

exhibits.title: Vision Transformers are Circulant Attention Learners
exhibits.mechanism: 高分辨率下，直接生成整张注意力图太贵。Circulant Attention 用块循环矩阵近似各位置的权重，把加权汇总交给快速傅里叶变换。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/循环注意力（CA-Circulant）

figure.caption: An illustration of vanilla self-attention and the proposed circulant attention. The $\sigma$ represents Softmax function, $\odot$ is the Hadamard product, and $\mathcal{F}_{\rm 2D},\mathcal{F}_{\rm 2D}^{-1}$ denote the 2D discrete Fourier transform (DFT) and its inversion, respectively. Our circulant attention largely inherits the paradigm of self-attention, except for employing BCCB attention matrices. This simple modification enables our design to be efficiently calculated through DFT-based multiplication, thereby achieving $\mathcal{O}(N\log N)$ complexity. The scaling factor and head-wise summation are omitted for simplicity. Please refer to Section 4 for details.

en.title: Vision Transformers are Circulant Attention Learners
en.mechanism: Circulant Attention approximates the dense score pattern with a block-circulant structure. That structure lets Fourier transforms apply the attention operator without a dense matrix multiplication.

exhibits.title: CUST  Clustered Unit-level Similarity Transformer for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
exhibits.mechanism: 重复纹理常落在两个窗口，普通窗口注意力看不到彼此。CANA 用池化后的窗口特征给图块聚类，各簇再读取相邻簇里匹配同一窗口的键和值。

en.title: CUST  Clustered Unit-level Similarity Transformer for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
en.mechanism: CANA groups patches by affinity to pooled window features, bringing similar textures together across window boundaries. Attention can also read matching keys and values from neighboring clusters.

exhibits.title: CIFNet Context Information Focused Network for Road Extraction From Remote Sensing Images
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感图里的道路可能被背景截断。CFEM 在标准卷积和空洞卷积上分别提取通道统计，合成 sigmoid 门，放大道路提取所需的特征。

figure.caption_zh: 两种池化结果都进入拼接与求和路径，融合后生成通道门控并重标定输入。

en.title: CIFNet Context Information Focused Network for Road Extraction From Remote Sensing Images
en.mechanism: CFEM combines channel summaries from standard and dilated convolution branches. Their pooled features produce a sigmoid gate that reweights the channels used for road segmentation.

en.title: Complex KDA: Understanding and Enhancing the Expressivity of Kimi Delta Attention
en.authors: Julien Siems, Riccardo Grazzi, Korbinian Pöppel, Jaisidh Singh, Arber Zela, Timur Carstensen, Jenia Jitsev, Frank Hutter, Volkan Cevher, Antonio Orvieto, Aaron Klein

exhibits.mechanism: 少样本异常检测要对齐颜色与几何线索，还要保留缺陷坐标。CooAtt 沿行和列分别池化、算门值，再回到原位置调节特征。

en.title: CMDS-AD Cross-Modal Dual-Stream Decoupling for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
en.mechanism: Small defects can disappear when color and geometry are fused too coarsely. Coordinate attention pools along rows and columns separately, producing weights that retain the location of each feature.

en.title: SP-KAN Sparse-sine perception Kolmogorov–Arnold networks for infraredsmall target detectio
en.mechanism: CViT keeps queries at full spatial resolution so small features can still be localized. It compresses the more redundant keys and values before the queries attend to them.

exhibits.title: Partial Decoder Attention Network with Contour Weighted Loss Function for Data-Imbalance M
exhibits.mechanism: 体积小的结构容易在分割时被大块组织掩盖。CWA 把编码器和解码器的特征拼接，经卷积和 softmax 得到互补权重，再用 SE 筛选融合后的通道。

en.title: Partial Decoder Attention Network with Contour Weighted Loss Function for Data-Imbalance M
en.mechanism: CWA learns a voxelwise balance between encoder detail and decoder context. A convolution and softmax produce complementary weights, and an SE block refines the channels after fusion.

exhibits.title: Multinex Lightweight Low-light Image Enhancement via Multi-prior Retinex
exhibits.mechanism: 低光图的亮度、颜色等先验在每个位置有不同用处。CWA 用逐通道卷积和点卷积为各分量生成空间权重，再逐点筛选这些先验特征。

en.title: Multinex Lightweight Low-light Image Enhancement via Multi-prior Retinex
en.mechanism: Multinex uses several cues to brighten an image. CWA gives each component its own spatial gate, so a useful luminance cue in one region need not dominate somewhere else.

en.mechanism: Screen layers blur an under-display camera image unevenly. After local refinement, channel-wise self-attention mixes channels using evidence from the full feature map to maintain global coherence.

en.mechanism: D-AAttn adapts its sampling grid to distorted images. Predicted offsets move the sampling positions, and each shifted window runs attention on the interpolated features.

en.title: DCMM-Transformer Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership Attention for Medical Imaging
en.mechanism: An image patch can belong partly to several anatomical groups. DCMM adds a learned score bias based on group memberships and connectivity, so those structures influence self-attention.

exhibits.title: Spectral Dynamic Attention Network for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
exhibits.mechanism: 高光谱图里，许多波段彼此重复。DCSA 先算通道两两的相关分数，再从当前图像估计该保留多少个，只让各行的高分项参与混合。

figure.caption: An input-predicted top-k mask sparsifies channel attention, whose output fuses with a local branch gated by Fourier magnitude.
figure.caption_zh: 模块从输入预测 Top-k 稀疏掩码，再将通道注意力结果与傅里叶幅值引导的局部分支融合。

en.title: Spectral Dynamic Attention Network for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
en.mechanism: DCSA scores interactions between spectral channels, then uses the input to decide how many scores to keep in each row. The strongest links guide super-resolution without weighting every redundant channel pair.

exhibits.name_zh: 动态方向梯度感知自注意力
exhibits.title: Gradient as Conditions Rethinking HOG for All-in-one Image Restoration
exhibits.mechanism: 模糊和雨痕会留下不同的方向梯度。DHOGSA 提取可学习的 HOG 特征，把这些退化线索带进自注意力，让远处位置的匹配随退化类型调整。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/动态方向梯度感知自注意力（DHOGSA）

en.title: Gradient as Conditions Rethinking HOG for All-in-one Image Restoration
en.mechanism: Blur and weather artifacts leave different gradient patterns. DHOGSA feeds learned histograms of oriented gradients into self-attention so long-range spatial matching can adapt to the degradation.

exhibits.name_zh: 动态空间通道交互模块
exhibits.title: Gradient as Conditions Rethinking HOG for All-in-one Image Restoration
exhibits.mechanism: 雨纹、模糊等退化需要不同的特征变换。DIFF 在前馈层里让空间信息和通道信息相互调节，给不同位置的通道分配不同分量。

en.title: Gradient as Conditions Rethinking HOG for All-in-one Image Restoration
en.mechanism: DIFF lets spatial and channel features modulate each other inside the feed-forward layer. This gives a restoration model room to respond differently to different kinds of degradation.

exhibits.title: Center-Pixel Guided Dual-Path Multihead Attention Fusion Transformer for Hyperspectral Ima
exhibits.mechanism: 高光谱图块要分的是中心像素，周围像素只提供线索。DMA 用中心像素查询空间邻域，用双向衰减给邻近波段更多权重，再把两路特征逐元素相乘。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/双路径多头注意力（DMA）

figure.caption_zh: 两个中心查询分别为位置加权和混合通道，两路结果相乘后投影。

en.title: Center-Pixel Guided Dual-Path Multihead Attention Fusion Transformer for Hyperspectral Ima
en.mechanism: DMA puts the center pixel in charge of spatial attention. A separate path favors nearby spectral bands with bidirectional decay, and elementwise multiplication brings the spatial and spectral responses together.

exhibits.name_zh: 可变形滑动窗口注意力
exhibits.title: DSwinIR Rethinking Window-based Attention for Image Restoration
exhibits.mechanism: 固定分窗让边缘图块只能看窗内的一侧。DSwinIR 给每个中心词元安排自己的滑窗，再按中心特征预测偏移，让窗口往相关的位置取样。

en.title: DSwinIR Rethinking Window-based Attention for Image Restoration
en.mechanism: DSwinIR centers a sliding neighborhood on each query token. Offsets predicted from that token move the sampling locations, so the restoration block can reach relevant features beyond a fixed window.

exhibits.title: Accelerating Vision Foundation Models with Drop-in Depthwise Convolution
exhibits.mechanism: 有些视觉注意力头几乎只看近邻，行为和卷积相似。这个方法找出这类头，再用深度卷积接管它们的局部混合。

en.title: Accelerating Vision Foundation Models with Drop-in Depthwise Convolution
en.mechanism: Some heads in a pretrained vision Transformer already behave like local filters. This method identifies those heads and replaces their attention with depthwise convolutions.

exhibits.name_zh: 贝叶斯双分支窗口注意力
exhibits.title: Bayesian Self-Attention with Intra-Token Modeling for Lightweight Denoising Transformers
exhibits.mechanism: 相似图块的平均值能去掉些噪声，却容易磨掉块里的纹理。DWSA 一路在窗口中加权汇总图块，另一路估计块内的二阶相关性，给去噪补上像素关系。

en.title: Bayesian Self-Attention with Intra-Token Modeling for Lightweight Denoising Transformers
en.mechanism: A weighted average of similar patches can wash out detail within a patch. DWSA pairs windowed patch aggregation with a second branch that estimates within-patch covariance for denoising.

exhibits.title: Advancing Vision Transformer With Enhanced Spatial Priors
exhibits.mechanism: 图像上的两点相隔多远，可以直接写进注意力。EuSA 按欧氏距离衰减配对权重，并分组计算，免去一次枚举全图的所有配对。

en.title: Advancing Vision Transformer With Enhanced Spatial Priors
en.mechanism: EuSA adds a geometric prior to visual attention by discounting weights with Euclidean distance. It computes attention in groups to control how many token pairs it has to score.

exhibits.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
exhibits.mechanism: 流式分离里，Falcon 在时频平面上做注意力，掩码挡住未来帧。

en.mechanism: Falcon applies self-attention over a flattened time-frequency grid. A causal mask lets each position read every frequency band in the current and past frames, so speaker extraction can stream.

figure.caption_zh: 多尺度 Hessian 响应融合成体素门控，用于缩放体数据，再加回原输入。

en.title: UDV-Net A hybrid CNN and transformer vein segmentation network with vascular prior and spa
en.mechanism: Veins have a tubular shape that can guide segmentation. A multiscale Frangi filter detects that structure and supplies weights for the encoder features.

figure.caption: Architecture of GSA2. Left: the hybrid backbone interleaves GSA2, MLP, and SWA blocks. Right: the GSA2 token mixer. The query and key branches apply linear projection, short convolution, SiLU, and L2 normalization, while the value branch follows the same pipeline without L2 normalization. The shared-slot branch uses a low-rank two-layer projection followed by short convolution, SiLU, and L2 normalization. Gated Oja Rule-2 and Gated Delta Rule-2 perform key- and value-side correction through shared latent slots, with separate decay, erase, and write gates controlling the two recurrent memories. The output is RMS-normalized, modulated by a sigmoid gate from a low-rank two-layer projection, and linearly projected.

en.title: Gated Slot Attention-2: Two-Sided Associative Memory Correction in Linear Attention
en.authors: Ruijie Li, Shengnan Ding, Weimin Zhang, Derick Tang, Zhanpeng Zeng, Qinsong Zeng, Ming Chen, Jiaxi Hu, Yuxuan Liang
en.mechanism: GSA2 corrects both sides of an association in a fixed-size memory. Shared slots link an Oja-rule update on the key side to a delta-rule update on the value side.

exhibits.title: Looking Beyond the Window: Global-Local Aligned CLIP for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
exhibits.mechanism: 滑窗各看各的，同一物体跨窗时可能被判成两类。GLA-CLIP 把所有窗口的键和值放到一起，再用与查询最相似的一组令牌作为跨窗比较的参照。

figure.caption: Comparison of segmentation consistency near window boundaries. (a) We evaluate segmentation inconsistency using the Boundary Error Rate (BER). BER is defined as the proportion of pixels near adjacent window boundaries where predicted labels differ despite identical ground-truth. ProxyCLIP yields high BER due to its lack of cross-window interaction, whereas BER is significantly reduced in ours by incorporating global context into attention process. More details in Appendix A. (b) ProxyCLIP exhibits grid artifacts (marked with white circles), caused by the limited receptive field within individual windows. In contrast, ours mitigates these artifacts by leveraging contextual information beyond local windows.

en.title: Looking Beyond the Window: Global-Local Aligned CLIP for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
en.mechanism: GLA-CLIP pools keys and values from all windows. For each query it builds an anchor from similar patches across the image, giving patches inside and outside the window a common reference.

figure.caption: GlobalSplat Architecture Overview. Given a sparse set of input views, image features are extracted via a View Encoder. A fixed set of learnable latent scene tokens is iteratively refined through a dual-branch encoder block (repeated $B$ times) designed to explicitly disentangle geometry and appearance. Within each branch, queries ( $Q_{G},Q_{A}$ ) cross-attend to multi-view features ( $K_{I},V_{I}$ ) and self-attend to global context. The streams are fused via a Mixer MLP to update the tokens for the subsequent block. Specialized Geometry and Appearance Decoders then transform these globally-aware tokens into explicit 3D Gaussians. As depicted on the right, the network employs a Coarse-to-Fine Training Curriculum strategy to progressively increase the decoded Gaussian capacity, supervised jointly by rendering, self-supervised consistency, and regularization losses.

en.title: GlobalSplat: Efficient Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Global Scene Tokens
en.mechanism: GlobalSplat uses a fixed set of scene tokens to gather evidence from every input view through cross-attention. It resolves overlap in those tokens before decoding the 3D Gaussians.

queue.note: 分级选择可见块并对高分块执行注意力细化。 固定提交的仓库树、README、pyproject.toml 和 HiLS 模块源码未声明可核对的再分发许可。Hugging Face 发布的 Apache-2.0 模型仓库包含权重和配置。已转入论文复现队列。

exhibits.license_note: 仓库根目录未见明确许可

figure.caption: An overview of HiLS-Attention. We omit the scaling factor $\frac{1}{\sqrt{d}}$ for simplicity. Naive block sparse attention selects the top- $K$ chunks by their exact mass $Z_{c}$, e.g., chunks 1 and 3 when $K=2$, but computing all $Z_{c}$ requires a full QK computation. HiLS-Attention instead uses compressed chunk keys $k^{\prime}_{c}$ to efficiently estimate a chunk-mass surrogate $Z^{\prime}_{c}\propto\exp(q^{\top}k^{\prime}_{c})$. It factorizes attention into two stages: an inter-chunk softmax, which specifies the total attention mass assigned to each chunk, and an intra-chunk softmax, which distributes each chunk’s attention mass among its tokens. Since $Z^{\prime}_{c}$ parameterizes the forward attention weights, gradients from the next-token prediction loss can be directly backpropagated to the compressed key $k^{\prime}_{c}$, enabling end-to-end learning.

en.title: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right: Toward Infinite Context Modeling
en.mechanism: HiLS gives each chunk a landmark for retrieval. A query attends separately inside the chunks it finds and mixes their readouts by retrieval score, so language-model training can teach it which chunks to select.

figure.caption: Model architecture used in our experiments. The KLA block is a drop-in replacement for Transformer or SSM blocks. We follow a similar block structure to Mamba, fusing the sequence mixing and gated MLP into a single block. We additionally employ QK-Norm and use an expansion factor of 1. Tokens are embedded and passed through a sequence mixer, then decoded to logits. The sequence mixer is a drop-in primitive that can be instantiated as attention variants, or other SSM/Filter modules. exhibits.mechanism: 第一轮问答之后，下一问可能落到图像的另一角。MetaCompress 学习怎样压缩视觉 token，压缩时不读当前问题，以便多轮共用。

en.title: Rethinking Token Reduction for Large Vision-Language Models
en.mechanism: A follow-up question can refer to a different corner of the image. MetaCompress learns a question-independent mapping that compresses visual tokens for reuse across turns.

figure.caption: Overview of MSA. The Index Branch (left) scores the full causal context with a single lightweight head and selects, for each query and GQA group, a set ${\mathcal{I}}$ of $k$ key blocks; the local block is always included regardless of its score. The Main Branch (right) attends only to the selected blocks and produces the layer output. During training, a KL loss aligns the index distribution with the group-averaged Main Branch distribution on the selected blocks, and the Index Branch gradient is detached from the Main Branch.

figure.caption: Muir co-designs asymmetric low-rank gate parameterization and matched-filter query readout with MXU tile alignment and iso-parameter FFN reallocation. (a) Standard residual block with a Muir token mixer. (b) Within the Muir block, ${\bm{x}}_{t}$ feeds linear- $\mathrm{Conv}$ - $\mathrm{SiLU}$ pathways for $({\bm{q}}_{t},{\bm{k}}_{t},{\bm{v}}_{t})$ alongside a single fused low-rank gate projection that produces all five gates $(\log{\bm{\alpha}}_{t},{\bm{b}}_{t},{\bm{g}}_{t},{\bm{w}}_{t},{\bm{\gamma}}_{t}).$ (c) Asymmetric gate ranks $(r_{f},r_{b},r_{g},r_{w},r_{q})=(64,64,128,128,128)$ sum to $R_{\mathrm{tot}}=512=2\times 256,$ which fills two $256$ -column MXU tiles in the fused down-projection and aligns $(f,b)$ and $(g,w,q)$ on $128$ -lane VMEM tile boundaries for batched up-projections. (d) At $d=2{,}048,$ replacing the dense $(b,w)$ gate matrices in GDN-2 cuts gate-projection parameters by $4.5\times$ ; this either reduces per-layer parameters and FLOPs by $14.6\%$ at fixed FFN width, or frees $+7.3\text{M}$ parameters per layer to widen the FFN under an iso-parameter budget.

en.authors: Zihan Qiu, Zekun Wang, Xiao Li, Yanpeng Li, Yang Xu, Yixuan Wang, Huaqing Zhang, Rui Men, Bochao Mao, Chengruidong Zhang, Fan Zhou, Hao Luo, Haofeng Huang, Haoran Lian, Haoyan Huang, Hongxuan Tang, Jianwei Zhang, Jing Xu, Junjie Wang, Langshi Chen, Liangyu Wang, Linlang Jiang, Man Yuan, Minmin Sun, Peng Jin, Siqi Zhang, Siyu Wang, Xingzhang Ren, Yakai Wang, Yi Zhang, Yiming Dong, Yizhong Cao, Yubo Ma, Yunfei Mao, Bo Zheng, Dayiheng Liu
en.mechanism: Qwen Sparse Attention scores small blocks with a compact indexer. It reserves detailed attention for the selected blocks, so it need not score every past token at full cost.

With the same state_dict and inputs, the maximum absolute differences for eager-branch outputs and attention weights were 0.

exhibits.title: RAPID: Reusing Attention Sparsity with Inter-step Adaptation for Efficient Video Diffusion
exhibits.mechanism: 视频去噪相邻几步里，值得算的注意力块往往差不多。RAPID 在早期给块打分，存下分数和稀疏掩码，后面的步直接拿来用，省去反复筛选。

en.title: RAPID: Reusing Attention Sparsity with Inter-step Adaptation for Efficient Video Diffusion
en.mechanism: RAPID scores attention blocks early in video denoising and caches the resulting sparse mask. Later steps reuse it, so they can skip the repeated search for important blocks.

exhibits.title: Fast and Accurate Image Restoration and Generation with Rank Enhanced Linear Attention
exhibits.mechanism: 线性注意力的低秩权重可能把不同位置混得太像。RELA 加入深度卷积补上局部变化，增加读出特征的秩。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/秩增强线性注意力（RELA）

figure.caption: Positive query and key features form normalized linear attention, and depthwise filtering of values supplies a local addition.
figure.caption_zh: 查询和键先映射为正值，再做归一化线性注意力，最后加上深度卷积处理后的值。

en.title: Fast and Accurate Image Restoration and Generation with Rank Enhanced Linear Attention
en.mechanism: RELA adds depthwise convolution to linear attention. The extra local mixing raises the rank of the output features, helping the network retain distinct details across the image.

exhibits.title: RetroInfer: A Vector Storage Engine for Scalable Long-Context LLM Inference
exhibits.authors: Yaoqi Chen, Jinkai Zhang, Baotong Lu, Qianxi Zhang, Chengruidong Zhang, Jing Liu, Jingjia Luo, Di Liu, Huiqiang Jiang, Qi Chen, Bailu Ding, Xiao Yan, Jiawei Jiang, Chen Chen, Mingxing Zhang, Cheng Li, Yuqing Yang, Fan Yang, Mao Yang
exhibits.mechanism: 把长文本缓存放到 CPU 可以省显存，逐词搬回来又太慢。RetroInfer 按段聚类缓存里的键，用面向注意力的向量索引找出要精读的部分，其余部分做近似。

exhibits.title: Dual Frequency Branch Framework with Reconstructed Sliding Windows Attention for AI-Genera
exhibits.mechanism: 辨认生成图像要看局部痕迹，全图注意力容易把这些细节冲淡。RSWAttention 把各频带的邻近特征拼到同一滑动窗口内，再比较窗口里的位置。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/重构滑动窗口注意力（RSWAttention）

figure.caption_zh: 每个窗口用点积权重混合通道，再用值的位置线性映射门控结果，最后拼回特征图。

en.title: Dual Frequency Branch Framework with Reconstructed Sliding Windows Attention for AI-Genera
en.mechanism: RSWAttention assembles nearby features from different frequency bands into each sliding window. Attention stays within that window, where it can compare local patterns that help identify a generated image.

exhibits.title: Freqformer Image-Demoiréing Transformer via Effective Frequency Decomposition
exhibits.mechanism: 摩尔纹对各颜色通道的影响不一样，也会随位置变化。SA-CA 先用卷积收集空间信息，再按这些信息在通道之间分配注意力。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/空间感知通道注意力（SA-CA）

figure.caption: Spatially filtered queries and keys score channel pairs per head, then the value mixture is projected and added to the input.
figure.caption_zh: 带空间滤波的查询和键为每个头的通道对打分，再混合值、投影并加回输入。

en.title: Freqformer Image-Demoiréing Transformer via Effective Frequency Decomposition
en.mechanism: Moiré affects color channels differently from one region to another. SA-CA first gathers spatial cues with convolutions, then uses them to guide interactions across channels.

exhibits.title: SAT Selective Aggregation Transformer for Image Super-Resolution
exhibits.mechanism: 超分辨率要靠远处纹理补细节，普通窗口只能看近处。SAA 按密度和孤立程度找代表图块，合并键和值，原分辨率的查询仍能读全图。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/选择性聚合注意力（SAA）

figure.caption: Density-selected centers merge tokens into compact keys and values, which full-length queries read through softmax attention.
figure.caption_zh: 模块按密度选择中心并合并词元，生成紧凑的键和值，再由全长查询用 Softmax 注意力读取。

en.title: SAT Selective Aggregation Transformer for Image Super-Resolution
en.mechanism: SAA keeps a query at every image position but replaces groups of keys and values with representative tokens. Density and isolation help choose those representatives so the global read can still retain fine detail.

exhibits.title: RoofX-Net A tailored approach to accurate multi-type rooftop segmentation in remote sensin
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感图上的小屋顶容易在粗尺度里消失。RoofX-Net 的 SAM 从普通卷积和空洞卷积取不同范围的响应，再汇聚这些尺度来分辨屋顶。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/尺度感知空间注意力（SAM-ISPRS2026）

figure.caption_zh: 两路卷积尺度生成随位置变化的门控，用于缩放输入，再加回原特征。

en.title: RoofX-Net A tailored approach to accurate multi-type rooftop segmentation in remote sensin
en.mechanism: RoofX-Net's Scale Awareness Module combines standard and dilated convolution responses. It gives a roof segmenter a wider view while keeping cues from small roof outlines.

exhibits.name_zh: 混合注意力多尺度模块
exhibits.title: SEMC Structure-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Contrastive Learning for Ultrasound Standard Pl
exhibits.mechanism: 超声切面的区别有时只在几条细小结构上。SAMC 用不同尺度的卷积处理特征，再依次算通道门和空间门，留下有辨识度的细节。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/混合注意力多尺度模块（SAMC）

en.title: SEMC Structure-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Contrastive Learning for Ultrasound Standard Pl
en.mechanism: SAMC uses parallel convolutions at several scales to capture small anatomical differences. Channel attention and then spatial attention refine those features before ultrasound plane recognition.

exhibits.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
exhibits.authors: Junsong Chen、Jincheng Yu、Yitong Li、Shuchen Xue、Haozhe Liu、Jingyu Xin、Yuyang Zhao、Tian Ye、Zhangjie Wu、Zian Wang、Daquan Zhou、Ping Luo、Song Han、Enze Xie

exhibits.title: LRDUN A Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network for Efficient Spectral Compressive Imaging
exhibits.mechanism: 恢复压缩的高光谱图像时，低秩表示也要看清较远的边缘和纹理。SCA 在空间子空间特征上用大感受野卷积汇集邻域，再按内容调节特征。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/空间卷积注意力（SCA-LRDUN）

figure.caption_zh: 深度空间滤波生成门控并调制逐点投影后的值，残差相加后再接卷积前馈层。

en.title: LRDUN A Low-Rank Deep Unfolding Network for Efficient Spectral Compressive Imaging
en.mechanism: SCA refines the spatial subspace used to reconstruct a hyperspectral image. Wide convolutional neighborhoods supply contextual cues for feature weighting without a dense spatial attention matrix.

exhibits.title: ParTY Part-Guidance for Expressive Text-to-Motion Synthesis
exhibits.mechanism: 分开生成手臂和腿的动作，合起来可能不协调。ParTY 先把全身和局部词元拼起来做自注意力，再让更新后的全身序列用交叉注意力读取部位动作。

copies.path: 论文复现/多模态学习/自交叉注意力（SCA-ParTY）

en.title: ParTY Part-Guidance for Expressive Text-to-Motion Synthesis
en.mechanism: ParTY first lets whole-body and part tokens interact through self-attention. The whole-body stream then queries the part streams so details such as arm or leg motion can guide a coordinated pose.

exhibits.name_zh: 双分支空间通道注意力
exhibits.title: Scan Clusters, Not Pixels A Cluster-Centric Paradigm for Efficient Ultra-high-definition I
exhibits.mechanism: 把超高清图像汇成少量簇中心，容易丢掉纹理。SCFM 在聚类分支旁给空间位置和通道分别加权，补回像素级细节。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/双分支空间通道注意力（SCFM）
copies.name_zh: 双分支空间通道注意力

en.title: Scan Clusters, Not Pixels A Cluster-Centric Paradigm for Efficient Ultra-high-definition I
en.mechanism: Cluster summaries can lose fine texture in very large images. SCFM runs spatial and channel attention alongside the cluster pathway to preserve local details.

exhibits.title: Statistical Characteristic-Guided Denoising for Rapid High-Resolution Transmission Electro
exhibits.mechanism: 电镜曝光短，图上的原子位置容易被噪声盖住。SDGW 用各位置附近的标准差算权重，决定那里该多用哪一种卷积响应。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/偏差引导空间注意力（SDGW）

figure.caption_zh: 局部标准差经 Sigmoid 生成门控，用于缩放另一条空间卷积分支的特征。

en.title: Statistical Characteristic-Guided Denoising for Rapid High-Resolution Transmission Electro
en.mechanism: Short electron-microscope exposures leave noisy images. SDGW uses local standard deviation to weight different convolution responses at each position, allowing the denoiser to vary by location.

exhibits.title: LWTformer A Detail-Aware, Learnable Wavelet-Transformer for Ancient Chinese Character Imag
exhibits.mechanism: 修复古文字时，细笔画和噪点容易混在一起。SEA 用多头线性层从值特征生成空间门，逐位置调节特征，再送进注意力汇聚。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/空间增强注意力（SEA）

en.title: LWTformer A Detail-Aware, Learnable Wavelet-Transformer for Ancient Chinese Character Imag
en.mechanism: SEA helps restore the structure of worn characters. It builds a spatial gate from the value features with per-head linear layers, so attention can retain fine strokes when it combines features.

exhibits.title: Selective Lookahead for Attention-Based Streaming ASR
exhibits.mechanism: 每层都向右多看一点，叠起来就可能等很久。Selective Lookahead 给注意力和卷积共用一条可见性规则，让前瞻始终止于固定数量的分块。

figure.caption: Dynamic future-chunk decoding. A per-token trigger commits most tokens immediately (green, zero added delay) and waits one chunk to re-decode only the uncertain few (orange): _IRIS is deferred and resolved to _IRISH once the next chunk arrives. $s_{t}$ is the trigger signal; the dashed line its threshold.

en.title: Selective Lookahead for Attention-Based Streaming ASR
en.mechanism: A little lookahead in each layer can accumulate into a long delay. Selective Lookahead shares a visibility rule across attention and convolution so the encoder's future reach stays fixed as layers are added.

exhibits.title: ORSIFlow Saliency-Guided Rectified Flow for Optical Remote Sensing Salient Object Detectio
exhibits.mechanism: 遥感图里目标尺寸差得很大，光靠全图线索难以描出边缘。SFC 用两路门控混合局部细节和较大范围的上下文，校准目标边界。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/轻量化混合注意力（SFC）

en.title: ORSIFlow Saliency-Guided Rectified Flow for Optical Remote Sensing Salient Object Detectio
en.mechanism: SFC refines the boundaries of salient objects in aerial images. Two gates blend local detail with broader context so the model can handle objects at different scales.

exhibits.title: A Dual-Stream UNet With Parallel ChannelSpatial Interaction and Aggregation for Change Det
exhibits.mechanism: 两期图像里，真实变化有时藏在相似的背景里。SGA 从两张特征图的空间位置算混合均值和联合方差，用它们构造高斯核来给差异加权。

en.title: A Dual-Stream UNet With Parallel ChannelSpatial Interaction and Aggregation for Change Det
en.mechanism: SGA looks for changes between images of the same scene at two times. It builds a spatial Gaussian kernel from their mixed mean and joint variance to expose differences that simpler fusion can miss.

exhibits.title: SLA2: Sparse-Linear Attention with Learnable Routing and Quantization-aware Training
exhibits.mechanism: SLA 按分数大小决定哪些块要精算，SLA2 把这件事交给可训练的路由器。路由器从压缩后的查询和键选块，模型还学习用多大的比例混合稀疏和线性结果。

figure.caption: Attention computation pipeline of SLA2.

en.title: SLA2: Sparse-Linear Attention with Learnable Routing and Quantization-aware Training
en.mechanism: SLA2 trains a router to choose sparse attention blocks from pooled queries and keys. It also learns how much of the final output to take from the sparse and linear branches.

exhibits.title: Softpick: No Attention Sink, No Massive Activations with Rectified Softmax
exhibits.mechanism: softmax 强制每行用完全部权重，有些位置会无故吸走注意力。Softpick 把低于零点的贡献截掉，保留分母归一化，但允许权重总和小于一。

en.title: Softpick: No Attention Sink, No Massive Activations with Rectified Softmax
en.mechanism: Softpick can give some tokens exactly zero weight. It rectifies attention weights and uses a denominator that lets the row sum fall short of one, reducing pressure to attend somewhere.

exhibits.title: SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT for Open-vocabulary Segmentation
exhibits.mechanism: 高分辨率分割常要把重叠滑窗逐个跑完。SPAR 让 ViT 在整图上算注意力，训练时拿滑窗拼接的特征作目标，推理时一次生成密集特征。

figure.caption: Overview of SPAR. During training, the teacher branch uses a frozen foundational vision encoder to generate feature maps via a sliding-window process followed by stitching. Stitching refers to merging the feature maps of overlapping windows into a unified representation aligned with the original image layout. The student branch, initialized from the same pre-trained weights, trains to match the teacher’s output using efficient single-pass inference. At inference time, the student model enables fast and accurate segmentation at diverse resolutions and aspect ratios using a single forward pass.

en.title: SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT for Open-vocabulary Segmentation
en.mechanism: SPAR trains a single-pass ViT to match the dense features of a sliding-window teacher. At inference it attends across the whole image and produces a feature map in one pass.

exhibits.title: SparVAR: Exploring Sparsity in Visual AutoRegressive Modeling for Training-Free Acceleration
exhibits.mechanism: 粗图里的注意力范围，到了细图还常用得上。SparVAR 把一个较粗尺度选出的键值块映射到后续尺度，并保留跨尺度的局部连接，少算细图里的全量注意力。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像生成与编辑/跨尺度稀疏注意力（SparVAR）

figure.caption: The illustration of $CS^{4}A$. The sparse index mapping process is omitted for clarity.

en.title: SparVAR: Exploring Sparsity in Visual AutoRegressive Modeling for Training-Free Acceleration
en.mechanism: SparVAR uses the attention pattern from an earlier scale to select key blocks at finer scales. It also keeps local links across scales, reducing attention work without skipping the fine generation stages.

exhibits.title: HSSDCT Factorized Spatial-Spectral Correlation for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
exhibits.mechanism: 高光谱融合要补空间细节，又要留住波段间的区别。SSC 分开计算空间和光谱相关性，再汇总两路特征，省去联合打分。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像复原与增强/空间光谱关联注意力（SSC）

figure.caption: Windowed spatial and spectral correlations mix shared values in parallel, then the restored grids are concatenated, projected, and transposed.
figure.caption_zh: 窗口内的空间相关与光谱相关并行混合同一组值，随后还原网格、拼接、投影并交换空间轴。

en.title: HSSDCT Factorized Spatial-Spectral Correlation for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
en.mechanism: Fusing spectral and spatial imagery calls for both fine geometry and distinct spectral bands. SSC factors the aggregation into separate spatial and spectral correlations to avoid a joint attention matrix.

exhibits.title: Low-Latency Event-Based Object Detection with Spatially-Sparse Linear Attention

queue.note: 事件视觉中的空间稀疏线性注意力。 固定提交的文件树、README 和 layers/mos_attention.py 未声明可核对的再分发许可，仓库也未登记许可证。已转入论文复现队列。

exhibits.mechanism: 事件相机每次多半只在少数位置有新信号，整份状态都改一遍很浪费。SSLA 把线性注意力状态分成空间小组，每个事件只更新和读取相关的组。

exhibits.verification: 式 (1) 到 (8) 和算法 1 一致。缺边界坐标约定、作者实现的输入限制、低精度输出范围

figure.caption: Overview of the Spatially-Sparse Linear Attention (SSLA) module. (a) The global state is decomposed into independent substates, one per overlapping patch in the spatial domain. (1) and (2) are $2\times 2$ patch examples that cover the event $e_{i}$ (for brevity, we omit the other patches covering $e_{i}$ ). Their states are updated with the embedding of $e_{i}$, and the output embedding of $e_{i}$ is the summation of the interim outputs from all the patches covering $e_{i}$. (b) In each patch, the embeddings are projected based on their relative position within the patch. (c) During training, with an event sequence as input, the events are scattered into patch-wise subsequences (duplicating each event across all the patches covering it), computed in parallel by a weight-shared linear attention, then gathered back to the original event order.

en.title: Low-Latency Event-Based Object Detection with Spatially-Sparse Linear Attention
en.mechanism: An event camera reports sparse changes, so each event need not update a dense memory. SSLA partitions linear attention into spatial states and activates only the states selected for that event.

exhibits.title: A Triple-Branch Architecture With Multiscale Attention for Spatiotemporal Remote Sensing F
exhibits.mechanism: 同一地点跨时相融合时，边界容易被平均得模糊。STAM 在空间支路给像素位置加权，再用 SE 根据全图统计调节通道，保留地物的结构线索。

en.title: A Triple-Branch Architecture With Multiscale Attention for Spatiotemporal Remote Sensing F
en.mechanism: STAM combines spatial attention with squeeze-and-excitation in the spatial branches of a remote-sensing fusion model. Location and channel weights help those branches preserve boundaries across observations.

exhibits.title: An efficient, scalable, and adaptable plug-and-play temporal attention module for motion-g
exhibits.mechanism: 逐帧分割心脏会丢掉运动信息，另做图像配准又容易传入误差。TAM 让不同帧的特征做多头交叉注意力，再用门控调节每对帧传递多少信息。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/轻量化时序注意力（TAM）

figure.caption: Temporal attention mixes frames at each location, then a per-frame spatial gate and convolution fuse the result with the original frames.
figure.caption_zh: 时间注意力在每个位置混合各帧，再通过逐帧空间门控和卷积与原始帧融合。

en.title: An efficient, scalable, and adaptable plug-and-play temporal attention module for motion-g
en.mechanism: TAM lets cardiac frames exchange motion cues through multihead cross-attention. Gates control the contribution from each frame pair, allowing a segmentation model to use temporal context without a separate registration step.

exhibits.title: TokenSplat: Token-aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Feed-forward Pose-free Reconstruction
exhibits.mechanism: 相机位姿和场景外观要同时估计，两种线索容易搅在一起。TokenSplat 在视图内让图像令牌互相做注意力，相机令牌也读同一视图的图像键和值，供位姿回归。

figure.caption: Overview of TokenSplat. TokenSplat performs feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction and camera pose estimation from unposed images. A shared ViT encoder extracts image tokens, which are processed by the Canonical Scene Decoder and the Asymmetric Dual-Flow Decoder (ADF-Decoder). The fused tokens are then used by the Token-aligned Gaussian Prediction module and the camera pose head to generate dense 3D Gaussians and accurate poses.

en.title: TokenSplat: Token-aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Feed-forward Pose-free Reconstruction
en.mechanism: TokenSplat separates scene and pose features in its decoder. Within a view, image tokens attend to each other, and a camera query reads their keys and values for pose prediction.

figure.caption: Overview of UniPrefill. Left: UniPrefill estimates token importance via block-level attention scores from the last $n$ queries (1), retains the smallest set of token blocks whose cumulative importance reaches $p$ (2), and propagates the resulting sparsity across all subsequent sub-layers within each repeating layer pattern (3). Right: UniPrefill is deeply integrated into vLLM via a fused kernel pipeline (4), with KV cache block tables (5), per-layer sequence length tracking (6), and tensor-parallel metadata synchronisation (7) updated accordingly.

en.title: UniPrefill: Universal Long-Context Prefill Acceleration via Block-wise Dynamic Sparsification
en.authors: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Bingning Wang and Ran He
en.mechanism: UniPrefill uses the final queries of a prompt to score earlier blocks. It keeps blocks up to a cumulative score threshold, cutting prefill work at the token level across different model architectures.

exhibits.title: VISion On Request: Enhanced VLLM efficiency with sparse, dynamically selected, vision-language interactions
exhibits.mechanism: 把视觉 token 删掉，细小文字也可能跟着消失。ViSOR 保留全部视觉 token，让文本用交叉注意力按需读取，只在选中的层做视觉自注意力。

figure.caption: Conceptual architecture of VISOR. Visual information is sparsely injected into the language stream via a few cross-attention and self-attention layers modelling text-image and image-image interactions. Cross-attention efficiently provides visual context to the text tokens without altering the visual representations. Self-attention, while more costly, refines the visual tokens, enabling subsequent cross-attention layers to access higher-level visual features. This design strikes a balance between efficiency and representational power.

en.title: VISion On Request: Enhanced VLLM efficiency with sparse, dynamically selected, vision-language interactions
en.mechanism: ViSOR keeps all high-resolution visual tokens available for cross-attention from text. A small set of selected self-attention layers refines those visual features when the task needs more detail.

exhibits.mechanism: 先池化再做通道门，会丢掉一些空间线索。GAM 重排三维特征再用 MLP 估计通道权重，接着用卷积算空间权重，给特征做两次缩放。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/全局注意力机制（GAM）

figure.caption: Generate channel gains from a per-position MLP, then derive a spatial sigmoid gate from the scaled features and apply it.
figure.caption_zh: 逐位置用 MLP 生成通道增益，再由缩放后的特征生成空间门控并逐点相乘。

en.title: Global Attention Mechanism Retain Information toEnhance Ch
en.mechanism: GAM keeps the feature map intact while estimating channel weights with an MLP on permuted features. A convolutional spatial gate then reweights the locations.

exhibits.title: Gather-Excite Exploiting Feature Context inConvolutional N
exhibits.mechanism: 卷积只看局部，位置附近有什么并不总能说明它属于哪里。Gather-Excite 先从更大范围汇总每个通道，再把汇总结果变成局部权重。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/聚合激励注意力（GENet）

figure.caption: Gather local context with average pooling, resize it to the feature grid, then apply sigmoid weights to scale the input.
figure.caption_zh: 在局部范围内做平均池化来汇总上下文，将其放大到原网格，再经 Sigmoid 生成缩放权重。

en.title: Gather-Excite Exploiting Feature Context inConvolutional N
en.mechanism: Gather-Excite gives local convolutional features access to a wider view. Its gather step pools channel responses over a large area, and its excite step feeds that context back as local weights.

exhibits.title: Large Separable Kernel Attention LSKA
exhibits.mechanism: 大二维卷积核很吃算力。LSKA 把深度卷积拆成先横后竖的一维卷积，再把算出的空间权重乘回特征图。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/视觉骨干与通用模块/大可分离核注意力（LSKA）

figure.caption: Run horizontal and vertical depthwise filters at two scales, then use a pointwise projection of the result to scale the input.
figure.caption_zh: 先后做两组横向和纵向深度卷积，再将结果逐点投影，用所得权重缩放输入。

en.title: Large Separable Kernel Attention LSKA
en.mechanism: LSKA builds a wide spatial gate with horizontal and vertical one-dimensional depthwise filters. The factorization lets a convolutional network use a much wider receptive field without the cost of a large square kernel.

exhibits.title: Relation-Aware Global Attention for Person Re-identification
exhibits.mechanism: 有人物被遮挡时，附近像素不足以判断哪块特征有用。RGA 把每个位置或通道与其余位置或通道的成对关系拼成向量，再结合自身特征预测权重。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分类与识别/关系感知全局注意力（RGA）

figure.caption: Pairwise spatial relations generate a spatial gate, then channel relations from the spatially gated map generate a second gate.
figure.caption_zh: 先用位置对关系生成空间门控，再从加权后的特征计算通道对关系，生成第二道门控。

en.title: Relation-Aware Global Attention for Person Re-identification
en.mechanism: RGA gives each location or channel a profile of its affinities to the rest of the feature map. A learned gate combines that profile with the local feature to decide what matters for re-identification.

exhibits.title: DuAT: Dual-Aggregation Transformer Network for Medical Image Segmentation
exhibits.mechanism: 深层特征指出物体大致在哪儿，浅层特征保留了边缘。SBA 让两种特征互相提供门值，把边界线索和物体内部的信息合起来。

copies.path: 论文复现/计算机视觉/图像分割/选择性边界聚合（SBA）

figure.caption: Compute a gate for each input, update the low-level map first, then use it to update the high-level map before resizing and fusing.
figure.caption_zh: 两路输入各自生成门控，先更新浅层特征，再用它更新深层特征，最后对齐尺寸并融合。

en.title: DuAT: Dual-Aggregation Transformer Network for Medical Image Segmentation
en.mechanism: SBA brings shallow boundary details together with deeper cues about the object as a whole. The two feature levels gate one another before their information is fused.
