story.thesis_zh:
这座馆里有 {n} 件注意力模块。最早的一件出自 2013 年，那个网络在学写字。最晚的几件出自 2026 年的大语言模型。导览从 2014 年的机器翻译讲起。它们改来改去的是同一个计算：给输入的每个位置打一个分，再按分数加权求和。

2017 年，这个计算自己成了一整个网络。此后的展品大多在收拾它留下的三件麻烦事。序列长一倍，计算量要到四倍。模型往外写得越长，要存的键和值越多。它自己还分不出谁先谁后。

导览分八个展室，按年代往下走。赶时间的话，可以只看第一、二、六、八室。
story.thesis_en:
This museum holds {n} attention modules. The earliest dates from 2013, in a network learning to write by hand. The latest come from the large language models of 2026. The tour begins with machine translation in 2014. All of them rework one computation: give every position of the input a score, then take a weighted sum.

In 2017 that computation became a whole network on its own. Most exhibits since then deal with three problems it left behind. Double the sequence and the cost quadruples. The longer a model writes, the more keys and values it must store. And it cannot tell first from last by itself.

The tour has eight rooms, in rough order of time. If you are short of time, see Rooms 1, 2, 6 and 8.

chapters.lede_zh: 2014 年的翻译模型先把整句源文压进一个定长向量，再一个词一个词往外译。句子一长，这个向量就装不下了。注意力最初只是一个补救办法：译每个词的时候，回头去源句里找该看的地方。
chapters.lede_en: In 2014 a neural translator squeezed the whole source sentence into one fixed-length vector, then wrote the translation word by word. Long sentences did not fit. Attention began as a patch: before writing each word, look back at the source and find the part that matters.

sections.text_zh:
Bahdanau 等人把话挑明了：定长向量是这套编码器加解码器结构的瓶颈。他们让解码器每生成一个目标词，就给源句的每个位置打一个分，再按分数把这些位置的表示加权求和。这组分数相当于一份软对齐，源句不用事先切成片段。英法翻译上，它追平了当时最好的短语翻译系统。

一年后 Luong 等人把这个想法拆开来试。全局注意力每一步看全部源词，局部注意力每一步只看一小段。在英德翻译上，局部注意力比不带注意力的系统高出 5.0 BLEU。
sections.text_en:
Bahdanau and colleagues said it plainly: the fixed-length vector is the bottleneck of the encoder-decoder design. Their decoder scores every source position each time it writes a target word, then takes a weighted sum of those positions. The scores work as a soft alignment, so the source never has to be cut into segments beforehand. On English-French it matched the best phrase-based system of the day.

A year later Luong and colleagues took the idea apart. Global attention looks at every source word at each step. Local attention looks at a small window. On English-German, local attention beat systems without attention by 5.0 BLEU.

anchors.note_zh: 一切从这里开始：解码器每译一个词，都对源句各位置重新打分。
anchors.note_en: Where it starts: the decoder rescores every source position for each word it writes.

anchors.note_zh: 把「看全部」和「只看一段」放在一起比，还试了几种算分数的办法。
anchors.note_en: Set looking at everything against looking at a window, and tried several ways to compute the score.

sections.text_zh:
打分、加权、求和，这三步很快就不只用在翻译上。Show, Attend and Tell 把源句换成图像的各个区域，模型每写一个词，先决定看图的哪一块。它给了两种训练办法：软注意力可以直接反向传播，硬注意力每次只采样一个区域，靠变分下界来训练。

Knowing When to Look 接着问了一个很实在的问题：写「the」「of」这种词，根本用不着看图，模型为什么每一步都得看？作者加了一个视觉哨兵，让模型每写一个词之前先决定这一步要不要看图。
sections.text_en:
Score, weight, sum. The three steps soon left translation. Show, Attend and Tell swapped the source sentence for regions of an image, so the model chooses where to look before each word of a caption. It came with two ways to train: soft attention, which backpropagates directly, and hard attention, which samples one region at a time and trains through a variational lower bound.

Knowing When to Look then asked a practical question. Words like "the" and "of" need no image at all, so why must the model look at every step? The authors added a visual sentinel that lets the model decide, word by word, whether to look.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力第一次看图：源句换成了图像区域。
anchors.note_en: Attention looks at a picture for the first time: image regions replace source words.

anchors.note_zh: 给模型一个「这一步不看图」的选项。
anchors.note_en: Gives the model the option not to look.

sections.text_zh:
同一时期还有一条线，把注意力当成读写存储的手段。神经图灵机用注意力读写一块外部存储，整个系统可以端到端求导（这一件本馆列在打算复现的名单里，还没有展品）。端到端记忆网络把原先需要逐步监督的记忆网络改成了端到端训练，输出之前可以对记忆读好几轮。键值记忆网络再往前一步，把「去哪里找」和「取什么回来」分开编码：用键定位，用值读出。「键」和「值」这两个词，后来成了注意力的标准说法。

指针网络换了一种用法。前面的模型都用注意力权重去混合编码器的状态，它直接把权重最大的那个输入位置当作输出。这样输出的可选范围就能随输入长度变化，凸包、Delaunay 三角剖分、旅行商这类问题都可以这么解。
sections.text_en:
A second line of work in the same years treated attention as a way to read and write memory. The Neural Turing Machine used attention to address an external memory, and the whole system stayed differentiable. (It is on this museum's list to reproduce and has no exhibit yet.) End-to-End Memory Networks removed the step-by-step supervision that earlier memory networks needed, and could read the memory several times before answering. Key-Value Memory Networks went one step further and encoded where to look separately from what to bring back: keys for addressing, values for reading. Those two words later became the standard vocabulary of attention.

Pointer Networks used the weights differently. Earlier models used them to blend encoder states. A pointer network takes the input position with the largest weight and returns it as the output. The set of possible outputs can then grow with the input, which suits problems such as convex hulls, Delaunay triangulation and the travelling salesman.

anchors.note_zh: 记忆网络从此可以端到端训练，一次回答之前读好几轮记忆。
anchors.note_en: Memory networks trained end to end, with several reads of memory before each answer.

anchors.note_zh: 用键找位置，用值取内容。
anchors.note_en: Keys find the place. Values carry the content.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力权重本身就是答案：它指向输入里的一个元素。
anchors.note_en: The attention weights are the answer: they point at one element of the input.

sections.text_zh:
到 2016、2017 年，注意力开始在两段文字之间来回比对。可分解注意力模型把自然语言推理拆成一批可以并行求解的小问题，完全不看词序，参数比前人的模型少了将近一个数量级。BiDAF 在问题和段落之间双向计算注意力，中途也不把段落压成一个定长向量。

不过到这时为止，注意力始终是挂在循环网络或别的主干上的一个部件。下一室讲它怎样自己成了主干。
sections.text_en:
By 2016 and 2017 attention was comparing two pieces of text against each other. The Decomposable Attention model broke natural language inference into small problems that can be solved in parallel. It ignored word order entirely and used almost an order of magnitude fewer parameters than earlier models. BiDAF ran attention in both directions between a question and a passage, and never compressed the passage into a single fixed-length vector along the way.

Through all of this, attention stayed a part bolted onto a recurrent network or some other backbone. The next room shows how it became the backbone.

anchors.note_zh: 只靠注意力做句子对比，不用循环网络，也不看词序。
anchors.note_en: Compares two sentences with attention alone: no recurrence, no word order.

anchors.note_zh: 问题看段落，段落也看问题。
anchors.note_en: The question attends to the passage, and the passage attends back.

anchors.note_zh: 一切从这里开始：解码器每译一个词，都对源句各位置重新打分。

anchors.note_en: Attention looks at a picture for the first time: image regions replace source words.

anchors.note_en: Gives the model the option not to look.

chapters.lede_zh: 上一室里，注意力一直是循环网络上的一个部件。2017 年有人把循环网络整个拿掉，只留注意力。一句话里的每个词同时去看其他所有的词，整句可以一起算。
chapters.lede_en: In the last room, attention was a part attached to a recurrent network. In 2017 someone took the recurrent network away and kept only the attention. Every word in a sentence looks at every other word at once, and the whole sentence is computed together.

sections.text_zh:
2017 年的翻译模型大多用循环网络或卷积做编码器和解码器，再用注意力把两头接起来。Vaswani 等人的 Transformer 只留下了中间这一段：编码器和解码器都由多头自注意力和前馈层一层层堆成。没有了循环，训练就不必一个词一个词地往下走，整个序列可以并行。

结果很干脆。WMT 2014 英德翻译得到 28.4 BLEU，比此前最好的成绩高出 2 BLEU 以上，被超过的成绩里还包括多个模型的集成。英法翻译用 8 张 GPU 训练 3.5 天，单个模型得到 41.8 BLEU。

自注意力不是这篇论文发明的。同年稍早，Lin 等人已经用它来生成句向量（本馆打算复现，还没有展品），不过在那里它还只是循环网络上面的一层。
sections.text_en:
Most translation models of 2017 used recurrent or convolutional networks for the encoder and the decoder, with attention as the link between them. The Transformer of Vaswani and colleagues kept only the link. Encoder and decoder alike are stacks of multi-head self-attention and feed-forward layers. With no recurrence, training no longer has to walk through a sentence one word at a time, and the whole sequence runs in parallel.

The results were blunt. On WMT 2014 English-German it scored 28.4 BLEU, more than 2 BLEU above the previous best, ensembles included. On English-French a single model reached 41.8 BLEU after 3.5 days on eight GPUs.

The paper did not invent self-attention. Earlier that year Lin and colleagues had used it to build sentence embeddings (on this museum's list to reproduce, with no exhibit yet), but there it was still one layer on top of a recurrent network.

anchors.note_zh: Transformer 里的多头注意力。本馆此后的大多数展品，都是在改它的某一步。
anchors.note_en: Multi-head attention from the Transformer. Most later exhibits in this museum change one step of it.

sections.text_zh:
拿掉循环，也就一并丢了两样东西。

一样是顺序。Transformer 的结构本身分不出谁在前谁在后，只能在输入上另加一份位置表示。这件事后来成了一整条研究线，放在第七室讲。

另一样是循环带来的那种「同一个步骤反复做」的倾向。Universal Transformer 的作者发现，标准 Transformer 连复制一个字符串都学不牢，输入只要比训练时见过的长就会出错。他们让同一层沿深度方向反复使用，并让每个位置自己决定算几轮就停。
sections.text_en:
Removing recurrence removed two other things with it.

One was order. Nothing in the Transformer's structure tells first from last, so a position signal has to be added to the input. That became a research line of its own, and Room 7 is devoted to it.

The other was the habit, built into a recurrent network, of applying the same step again and again. The authors of the Universal Transformer found that a standard Transformer cannot reliably learn even to copy a string: it fails once the input is longer than anything seen in training. They reused one layer repeatedly along the depth of the network and let each position decide how many rounds to run before stopping.

anchors.note_zh: 同一层反复用，把循环带回 Transformer，每个位置自己决定什么时候停。
anchors.note_en: Reuses one layer over and over to bring recurrence back, and lets each position choose when to halt.

sections.text_zh:
自注意力很快被搬到了翻译以外的数据上。

QANet 做阅读理解，编码器里只有卷积和自注意力，卷积管近处，自注意力管全局，在 SQuAD 上训练比循环网络的模型快 3 到 13 倍。GAT 把它搬到图上：每个节点只给自己的邻居打分，不用对矩阵求逆，也不用事先知道整张图长什么样。Set Transformer 处理没有顺序的集合，并从稀疏高斯过程里借来「诱导点」的办法，把自注意力的计算量从平方降到线性。SAGAN 把它放进生成对抗网络，生成图像某一处的细节时，可以参考图上所有位置。
sections.text_en:
Self-attention soon moved to data other than translation.

QANet, built for reading comprehension, has only convolution and self-attention in its encoder: convolution for what is nearby, self-attention for the whole passage. It trains 3 to 13 times faster on SQuAD than recurrent models. GAT took self-attention to graphs. Each node scores only its neighbours, with no matrix inversion and no need to know the whole graph in advance. Set Transformer handles sets, which have no order, and borrows inducing points from sparse Gaussian processes to bring the cost of self-attention down from quadratic to linear. SAGAN put self-attention inside a generative adversarial network, so a detail anywhere in the image can draw on every other location.

anchors.note_zh: 阅读理解的编码器不用循环网络：卷积看近处，自注意力看全篇。
anchors.note_en: A reading-comprehension encoder with no recurrence: convolution for nearby words, self-attention for the whole passage.

anchors.note_zh: 图上的自注意力，每个节点只看邻居。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention on a graph, where each node looks only at its neighbours.

anchors.note_zh: 给无序集合用的注意力，用少量诱导点代替两两比较。
anchors.note_en: Attention for unordered sets, with a few inducing points in place of all-pairs comparison.

anchors.note_zh: 生成图像时，远处的像素也能互相参考。
anchors.note_en: Lets distant parts of a generated image inform each other.

sections.text_zh: 音乐和语音的序列比句子长得多，也更在意两个音之间隔了多久。Music Transformer 指出，Shaw 等人的相对位置做法要存一份随长度平方增长的中间结果，长曲子根本放不下。他们把这份存储降到线性，生成了一分钟长的乐曲。Conformer 做语音识别，把卷积和 Transformer 合在一个模块里，卷积负责相邻几帧，自注意力负责整段话。
sections.text_en: Music and speech run far longer than sentences, and care more about how far apart two events are. Music Transformer pointed out that the relative-position scheme of Shaw and colleagues stores an intermediate result that grows with the square of the length, which a long piece cannot afford. They cut that storage to linear and generated compositions a minute long. Conformer, for speech recognition, joins convolution and the Transformer in one block: convolution for neighbouring frames, self-attention for the whole utterance.

anchors.note_zh: 把相对位置注意力的内存从平方降到线性，才写得出一分钟的曲子。
anchors.note_en: Cuts the memory of relative-position attention from quadratic to linear, enough to write a minute of music.

anchors.note_zh: 语音识别里卷积和自注意力搭档：一个听相邻几帧，一个听整句。
anchors.note_en: Convolution and self-attention paired for speech: one hears neighbouring frames, the other the whole utterance.

anchors.note_zh: Transformer 里的多头注意力。本馆此后的大多数展品，都是在改它的某一步。
anchors.note_en: Multi-head attention from the Transformer. Most later exhibits in this museum change one step of it.

anchors.note_zh: 同一层反复用，把循环带回 Transformer，每个位置自己决定什么时候停。
anchors.note_en: Reuses one layer over and over to bring recurrence back, and lets each position choose when to halt.

anchors.note_zh: 阅读理解的编码器不用循环网络：卷积看近处，自注意力看全篇。
anchors.note_en: A reading-comprehension encoder with no recurrence: convolution for nearby words, self-attention for the whole passage.

anchors.note_zh: 图上的自注意力，每个节点只看邻居。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention on a graph, where each node looks only at its neighbours.

anchors.note_zh: 给无序集合用的注意力，用少量诱导点代替两两比较。
anchors.note_en: Attention for unordered sets, with a few inducing points in place of all-pairs comparison.

anchors.note_zh: 生成图像时，远处的像素也能互相参考。
anchors.note_en: Lets distant parts of a generated image inform each other.

anchors.note_zh: 把相对位置注意力的内存从平方降到线性，才写得出一分钟的曲子。
anchors.note_en: Cuts the memory of relative-position attention from quadratic to linear, enough to write a minute of music.

anchors.note_zh: 语音识别里卷积和自注意力搭档：一个听相邻几帧，一个听整句。
anchors.note_en: Convolution and self-attention paired for speech: one hears neighbouring frames, the other the whole utterance.

chapters.body_zh:
2017 年的翻译模型大多用循环网络或卷积做编码器和解码器，再用注意力把两头接起来。Vaswani 等人的 Transformer 只留下了中间这一段：编码器和解码器都由多头自注意力和前馈层一层层堆成。没有了循环，训练就不必一个词一个词地往下走，整个序列可以并行。

结果很干脆。WMT 2014 英德翻译得到 28.4 BLEU，比此前最好的成绩高出 2 BLEU 以上，被超过的成绩里还包括多个模型的集成。英法翻译用 8 张 GPU 训练 3.5 天，单个模型得到 41.8 BLEU。

自注意力不是这篇论文发明的。同年稍早，Lin 等人已经用它来生成句向量（本馆打算复现，还没有展品），不过在那里它还只是循环网络上面的一层。

拿掉循环，也就一并丢了两样东西。

一样是顺序。Transformer 的结构本身分不出谁在前谁在后，只能在输入上另加一份位置表示。这件事后来成了一整条研究线，放在第七室讲。

另一样是循环带来的那种「同一个步骤反复做」的倾向。Universal Transformer 的作者发现，标准 Transformer 连复制一个字符串都学不牢，输入只要比训练时见过的长就会出错。他们让同一层沿深度方向反复使用，并让每个位置自己决定算几轮就停。

自注意力很快被搬到了翻译以外的数据上。

QANet 做阅读理解，编码器里只有卷积和自注意力，卷积管近处，自注意力管全局，在 SQuAD 上训练比循环网络的模型快 3 到 13 倍。GAT 把它搬到图上：每个节点只给自己的邻居打分，不用对矩阵求逆，也不用事先知道整张图长什么样。Set Transformer 处理没有顺序的集合，并从稀疏高斯过程里借来「诱导点」的办法，把自注意力的计算量从平方降到线性。SAGAN 把它放进生成对抗网络，生成图像某一处的细节时，可以参考图上所有位置。

音乐和语音的序列比句子长得多，也更在意两个音之间隔了多久。Music Transformer 指出，Shaw 等人的相对位置做法要存一份随长度平方增长的中间结果，长曲子根本放不下。他们把这份存储降到线性，生成了一分钟长的乐曲。Conformer 做语音识别，把卷积和 Transformer 合在一个模块里，卷积负责相邻几帧，自注意力负责整段话。
chapters.body_en:
Most translation models of 2017 used recurrent or convolutional networks for the encoder and the decoder, with attention as the link between them. The Transformer of Vaswani and colleagues kept only the link. Encoder and decoder alike are stacks of multi-head self-attention and feed-forward layers. With no recurrence, training no longer has to walk through a sentence one word at a time, and the whole sequence runs in parallel.

The results were blunt. On WMT 2014 English-German it scored 28.4 BLEU, more than 2 BLEU above the previous best, ensembles included. On English-French a single model reached 41.8 BLEU after 3.5 days on eight GPUs.

The paper did not invent self-attention. Earlier that year Lin and colleagues had used it to build sentence embeddings (on this museum's list to reproduce, with no exhibit yet), but there it was still one layer on top of a recurrent network.

Removing recurrence removed two other things with it.

One was order. Nothing in the Transformer's structure tells first from last, so a position signal has to be added to the input. That became a research line of its own, and Room 7 is devoted to it.

The other was the habit, built into a recurrent network, of applying the same step again and again. The authors of the Universal Transformer found that a standard Transformer cannot reliably learn even to copy a string: it fails once the input is longer than anything seen in training. They reused one layer repeatedly along the depth of the network and let each position decide how many rounds to run before stopping.

Self-attention soon moved to data other than translation.

QANet, built for reading comprehension, has only convolution and self-attention in its encoder: convolution for what is nearby, self-attention for the whole passage. It trains 3 to 13 times faster on SQuAD than recurrent models. GAT took self-attention to graphs. Each node scores only its neighbours, with no matrix inversion and no need to know the whole graph in advance. Set Transformer handles sets, which have no order, and borrows inducing points from sparse Gaussian processes to bring the cost of self-attention down from quadratic to linear. SAGAN put self-attention inside a generative adversarial network, so a detail anywhere in the image can draw on every other location.

Music and speech run far longer than sentences, and care more about how far apart two events are. Music Transformer pointed out that the relative-position scheme of Shaw and colleagues stores an intermediate result that grows with the square of the length, which a long piece cannot afford. They cut that storage to linear and generated compositions a minute long. Conformer, for speech recognition, joins convolution and the Transformer in one block: convolution for neighbouring frames, self-attention for the whole utterance.

chapters.lede_zh: 做视觉的人问的是另一个问题：一张特征图里，哪些通道要紧，哪些位置要紧？他们的答案大多是一个几十行的小模块，往现成的卷积网络里一插就能用。
chapters.lede_en: Vision researchers asked a different question: within one feature map, which channels matter, and which positions? Their answers were mostly small modules, a few dozen lines each, that drop into an existing convolutional network.

sections.text_zh: 最早的尝试还不叫注意力。2015 年的空间变换网络在网络中间学一个几何变换，看着特征图自己的内容，决定把它平移、缩放还是转个角度，不需要额外的标注。2017 年的残差注意力网络用一个先下采样再上采样的支路生成注意力图，又借残差连接的思路，让带注意力的网络可以堆到几百层。
sections.text_en: The earliest attempts did not yet call themselves attention. The Spatial Transformer Network of 2015 learns a geometric transform in the middle of a network. It looks at the feature map itself and decides whether to shift, scale or rotate it, with no extra labels. The Residual Attention Network of 2017 builds its attention maps with a branch that downsamples and then upsamples, and borrows the idea of residual connections so that a network with attention can be stacked hundreds of layers deep.

anchors.note_zh: 让网络自己把特征图摆正：学一个平移、缩放、旋转的变换。
anchors.note_en: Lets the network straighten its own feature map by learning to shift, scale and rotate it.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力模块配上残差连接，几百层也训得动。
anchors.note_en: Attention modules with residual connections, trainable at hundreds of layers.

sections.text_zh:
2018 年的 SE 模块把问题缩到通道上。它给每个通道算一个权重，再把通道的响应按权重重新调一遍。做法很简单，效果却足够拿下 ILSVRC 2017 分类赛的第一名，top-5 错误率 2.251%。

CBAM 接着补上了位置：先算通道注意力，再算一张空间注意力图，两样依次乘回特征图。同一年做图像超分辨率的 RCAN 也用了通道注意力，本馆把它收在图像复原那一厅。
sections.text_en:
The SE block of 2018 narrowed the question to channels. It computes one weight per channel and rescales each channel's response by it. The idea is simple, and it was enough to win the ILSVRC 2017 classification challenge with a top-5 error of 2.251%.

CBAM then added position. It computes channel attention first, then a spatial attention map, and multiplies both back into the features in turn. RCAN, a super-resolution network from the same year, uses channel attention too. This museum keeps it in the image restoration hall.

anchors.note_zh: 给每个通道一个权重。这一室后面的展品，多半都在回应它。
anchors.note_en: One weight per channel. Much of what follows in this room answers it.

anchors.note_zh: 通道之后再看位置，两张注意力图先后乘回去。
anchors.note_en: Channels first, then positions: two attention maps applied one after the other.

sections.text_zh:
同一年，Non-local 网络从另一头走了过来。卷积一次只看一小块邻域，Non-local 把一个位置的输出写成所有位置特征的加权和，隔得再远也能直接联系上。论文里说得明白：机器翻译里的自注意力，就是这种非局部操作的一个特例。上一室的东西，就这样进了卷积网络。

代价是每个位置都要和所有位置算一遍。CCNet 的办法是让每个像素只看自己所在的那一行和那一列，连做两轮，信息就传遍了全图。和 Non-local 相比，显存少用 11 倍，计算量少约 85%。做分割的 DANet 则把位置注意力和通道注意力并排放在一起。
sections.text_en:
In the same year the Non-local network arrived from the other direction. A convolution sees one small neighbourhood at a time. A non-local block writes the output at one position as a weighted sum of the features at every position, so distant points connect directly. The paper says so outright: self-attention in machine translation is a special case of this non-local operation. That is how the subject of the previous room entered the convolutional network.

The cost is that every position must be compared with every other. CCNet lets each pixel look only along its own row and column, then repeats the step once more so that information reaches the whole image. Against the non-local block it uses 11 times less GPU memory and about 85% less computation. DANet, a segmentation network, places position attention and channel attention side by side.

anchors.note_zh: 自注意力进入视觉：每个位置都是全图所有位置的加权和。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention enters vision: each position becomes a weighted sum over the whole image.

anchors.note_zh: 只看同一行和同一列，算两轮就覆盖全图。
anchors.note_en: Looks only along its row and column. Two rounds cover the image.

sections.text_zh:
2019 年的 GCNet 把这两条线接到了一起。作者发现，Non-local 给图上不同位置算出来的全局上下文几乎一模一样，那就没必要每个位置各算一份，算一份大家共用就行。这样简化之后，结构和 SE 很像，他们索性把两者写成同一个三步框架。

再往后的改进，一是减重，二是把位置信息补回来。ECA 把 SE 拆开来看，发现里面的降维对学通道权重有害，于是去掉降维，改用一维卷积，只让相邻的几个通道互相商量。坐标注意力沿着高和宽两个方向分别汇总特征，通道权重里就带上了位置。
sections.text_en:
GCNet joined the two lines in 2019. Its authors found that the global context a non-local block computes is almost the same for every position in the image. There is then no need to compute it once per position: compute it once and share it. Simplified this way, the block looks much like SE, and the authors wrote both as a single three-step framework.

Later work cut weight and put position back in. ECA took SE apart and found that its dimensionality reduction hurts the learning of channel weights. It dropped the reduction and used a one-dimensional convolution so that each channel consults only a few neighbours. Coordinate Attention pools features along height and along width separately, so the channel weights carry position with them.

anchors.note_zh: 全局上下文只算一份，大家共用。Non-local 和 SE 从此是一家。
anchors.note_en: Computes the global context once and shares it. Non-local and SE turn out to be one family.

anchors.note_zh: 去掉 SE 里的降维，相邻通道之间用一维卷积交流。
anchors.note_en: Drops the dimensionality reduction in SE and lets neighbouring channels talk through a 1D convolution.

anchors.note_zh: 沿高和宽分别汇总，通道注意力从此知道东西在哪。
anchors.note_en: Pools along height and width separately, so channel attention knows where things are.

anchors.note_zh: 让网络自己把特征图摆正：学一个平移、缩放、旋转的变换。
anchors.note_en: Lets the network straighten its own feature map by learning to shift, scale and rotate it.

chapters.title_zh: 视觉 Transformer：窗口、金字塔和采样点
chapters.title_en: Vision Transformers: Windows, Pyramids and Sampling Points
chapters.lede_zh: 上一室的模块，是在卷积旁边补一点全局信息。2019 年以后事情倒了过来：视觉模型拿注意力当主干，再回头把卷积擅长的两样本事补上，一样是先看近处，一样是大小物体都照顾到。
chapters.lede_en: The modules in the last room added a little global information beside the convolutions. After 2019 the arrangement flipped. Vision models took attention as the backbone, then worked to recover two things convolution does well: looking nearby first, and handling objects of every size.

sections.text_zh:
先有人试着直接替换卷积。2019 年的注意力增强卷积指出，卷积只在一小块邻域里运算，看不到全局。作者设计了带二维相对位置的自注意力，单独拿它替换卷积已经有竞争力，把它的输出和卷积的输出拼在一起效果最好。

2020 年 Zhao 等人把问题问得更彻底：整套识别网络只用自注意力搭，行不行？他们比较了两种做法。成对的自注意力和上一室的一样，本质上是对一个集合做运算。成块的自注意力则严格强于卷积。
sections.text_en:
First came attempts to replace convolution directly. Attention Augmented Convolution, in 2019, pointed out that a convolution works on one small neighbourhood and cannot see the whole image. Its authors designed self-attention with two-dimensional relative positions. Used alone in place of convolution it was already competitive, and it worked best when its output was concatenated with the convolution's.

In 2020 Zhao and colleagues pushed the question further: can a whole recognition network be built from self-attention alone? They compared two forms. Pairwise self-attention, the kind seen in the last room, is in essence an operation on a set. Patchwise self-attention is strictly more powerful than convolution.

anchors.note_zh: 给自注意力配上二维相对位置，和卷积的输出拼在一起用。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention with 2D relative positions, concatenated with the output of a convolution.

anchors.note_zh: 不用卷积，只用自注意力搭出一整套识别网络。
anchors.note_en: A whole recognition network built from self-attention, with no convolution.

sections.text_zh:
ViT 把图像切成小块，像处理一句话那样直接送进 Transformer 做分类（这一件本馆还没有收）。PVT 的作者随即指出它的短处：ViT 是为分类设计的，输出的分辨率低，计算和内存开销又大，很难直接拿去做检测和分割。PVT 的办法是做成金字塔，特征图一级一级缩小，大图上的计算量就降了下来，可以直接顶替卷积骨干。

Swin Transformer 走的是另一条路。它只在互不重叠的小窗口里算自注意力，到下一层把窗口挪开半个窗口的距离，信息就能跨窗口流动。这样一来，计算量随图像尺寸线性增长。SwinIR 很快把这套窗口注意力用到了超分辨率和去噪上。
sections.text_en:
ViT cuts an image into patches and feeds them to a Transformer for classification, the way one would feed a sentence. (This museum does not hold it yet.) The authors of PVT soon named its weakness. ViT was designed for classification: its output resolution is low and its compute and memory costs are high, so it is hard to use directly for detection or segmentation. PVT builds a pyramid. The feature map shrinks stage by stage, which cuts the cost on large images and lets the model stand in for a convolutional backbone.

Swin Transformer went another way. It computes self-attention only inside small non-overlapping windows, then shifts the windows by half a window in the next layer so that information crosses between them. Computation then grows linearly with image size. SwinIR quickly applied the same window attention to super-resolution and denoising.

anchors.note_zh: 金字塔结构，特征图逐级缩小，Transformer 才做得了检测和分割。
anchors.note_en: A pyramid whose feature maps shrink stage by stage, which makes detection and segmentation feasible.

anchors.note_zh: 只在小窗口里算注意力，下一层把窗口挪开半格。
anchors.note_en: Attention inside small windows, shifted by half a window in the next layer.

anchors.note_zh: Swin 的窗口注意力用来修图：超分辨率、去噪。
anchors.note_en: Swin's window attention put to work restoring images: super-resolution and denoising.

sections.text_zh:
检测是另一条线。DETR 用 Transformer 做端到端的目标检测（本馆同样还没有收），但它收敛很慢，用得起的特征分辨率也有限。可变形 DETR 让每个查询只看参考点周围的几个采样点，不再看全图。训练轮数少了 10 倍，小物体也检得更准。

这种采样的办法来自 2017 年的可变形卷积：采样位置往哪偏，从任务里自己学出来，不需要额外的标注。
sections.text_en:

sections.text_en: Later work looked for a balance between near and far. anchors.note_zh: 先看块内，再隔着间距看全图，两步加起来仍是线性的计算量。
anchors.note_en: Blocks first, then a spaced-out grid over the whole image. The two steps together stay linear.

anchors.note_zh: 每个像素只看最近的邻居，像卷积核一样滑过去。
anchors.note_en: Each pixel looks at its nearest neighbours and slides along like a kernel.

anchors.note_zh: 先整块去掉不相干的区域，再在剩下的地方细看。
anchors.note_en: Drops irrelevant regions wholesale, then looks closely at what is left.

anchors.note_zh: 给自注意力配上二维相对位置，和卷积的输出拼在一起用。

anchors.note_zh: 不用卷积，只用自注意力搭出一整套识别网络。

anchors.note_zh: 金字塔结构，特征图逐级缩小，Transformer 才做得了检测和分割。
anchors.note_en: A pyramid whose feature maps shrink stage by stage, which makes detection and segmentation feasible.

anchors.note_zh: 只在小窗口里算注意力，下一层把窗口挪开半格。
anchors.note_en: Attention inside small windows, shifted by half a window in the next layer.

anchors.note_zh: Swin 的窗口注意力用来修图：超分辨率、去噪。
anchors.note_en: Swin's window attention put to work restoring images: super-resolution and denoising.

2020 年 Zhao 等人把问题问得更彻底：整套识别网络只用自注意力搭，行不行？他们比较了两种做法。成对的自注意力和上一室的一样，本质上是对一个集合做运算。成块的自注意力则严格强于卷积。

Swin Transformer 走的是另一条路。它只在互不重叠的小窗口里算自注意力，到下一层把窗口挪开半个窗口的距离，信息就能跨窗口流动。这样一来，计算量随图像尺寸线性增长。SwinIR 很快把这套窗口注意力用到了超分辨率和去噪上。

检测是另一条线。DETR 用 Transformer 做端到端的目标检测（本馆同样还没有收），但它收敛很慢，用得起的特征分辨率也有限。可变形 DETR 让每个查询只看参考点周围的几个采样点，不再看全图。训练轮数少了 10 倍，小物体也检得更准。

这种采样的办法来自 2017 年的可变形卷积：采样位置往哪偏，从任务里自己学出来，不需要额外的标注。

chapters.body_en:
First came attempts to replace convolution directly. Attention Augmented Convolution, in 2019, pointed out that a convolution works on one small neighbourhood and cannot see the whole image. Its authors designed self-attention with two-dimensional relative positions. Used alone in place of convolution it was already competitive, and it worked best when its output was concatenated with the convolution's.

In 2020 Zhao and colleagues pushed the question further: can a whole recognition network be built from self-attention alone? They compared two forms. Pairwise self-attention, the kind seen in the last room, is in essence an operation on a set. Patchwise self-attention is strictly more powerful than convolution.

ViT cuts an image into patches and feeds them to a Transformer for classification, the way one would feed a sentence. (This museum does not hold it yet.) The authors of PVT soon named its weakness. ViT was designed for classification: its output resolution is low and its compute and memory costs are high, so it is hard to use directly for detection or segmentation. PVT builds a pyramid. The feature map shrinks stage by stage, which cuts the cost on large images and lets the model stand in for a convolutional backbone.

Swin Transformer went another way. It computes self-attention only inside small non-overlapping windows, then shifts the windows by half a window in the next layer so that information crosses between them. Computation then grows linearly with image size. SwinIR quickly applied the same window attention to super-resolution and denoising.

Detection is a separate line. DETR does object detection end to end with a Transformer (also not yet held here), but it converges slowly and can afford only limited feature resolution. Deformable DETR lets each query look at a few sampling points around a reference point instead of the whole image. It needs ten times fewer training epochs and detects small objects better.

The sampling idea comes from Deformable Convolution in 2017: where to move each sampling point is learned from the task itself, with no extra labels.

Later work looked for a balance between near and far. MaxViT splits attention into two steps: first within small blocks for what is close, then across a fixed grid for the whole image. The cost stays linear whatever the input size. Neighborhood Attention lets each pixel look only at its nearest ring of neighbours and slides across the image like a convolution kernel. BiFormer filters at two levels. It first drops the least relevant regions wholesale, then applies fine-grained attention within the regions that remain.

chapters.lede_zh: 第一室里的看图说话，是注意力第一次跨在图像和文字中间。这以后问题换了三回。先是「写每个词的时候看图的哪里」，然后是「图和字怎样在一个网络里互相交换信息」，最后是「怎样把图接到一个现成的大语言模型上」。
chapters.lede_en: Image captioning, in Room 1, was the first time attention stood between a picture and a sentence. The question has changed three times since. First: where in the image to look while writing each word. Then: how images and text can trade information inside one network. Finally: how to attach an image to a large language model that already exists.

sections.text_zh:
2018 年的自底向上和自顶向下注意力，换掉了注意力看的单位。以前是把图切成均匀的格子，它先用 Faster R-CNN 找出图里的一个个物体区域，再由任务决定每个区域该占多少权重。这个模型拿了 2017 年 VQA 挑战赛的第一名。

接下来的两件都在琢磨图和问题怎样互相看。BAN 觉得当时的协同注意力太省事：给图像和问题各算一个注意力分布，两者之间的交互就漏掉了。可要是每一对图像区域和问题词都单独学，又算不起。它用双线性注意力取了个折中。MCAN 则发现，协同注意力模型往深里堆，几乎得不到好处。它把三样东西组成一层：问题自己的自注意力，图像自己的自注意力，问题引导图像的注意力。这样的层才堆得深。
sections.text_en:
Bottom-Up and Top-Down Attention, in 2018, changed the unit that attention looks at. Earlier models cut the image into an even grid. This one first uses Faster R-CNN to find object regions, then lets the task decide how much weight each region gets. It took first place in the 2017 VQA Challenge.

The next two exhibits both work on how an image and a question should look at each other. BAN found the co-attention of the day too frugal: one attention distribution for the image and one for the question leaves out the interaction between them. Yet learning attention for every pair of image region and question word costs too much. Bilinear attention was its compromise. MCAN found that co-attention models gain almost nothing from added depth. It built a layer from three parts: self-attention over the question, self-attention over the image, and attention over the image guided by the question. Layers of that kind can be stacked deep.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力不再看格子，改看检测出来的一个个物体。
anchors.note_en: Attention stops looking at grid cells and looks at detected objects.

anchors.note_zh: 用双线性注意力，把图像区域和问题词两两之间的关系算进来。
anchors.note_en: Bilinear attention that accounts for every pairing of image region and question word.

anchors.note_zh: 自注意力加上问题引导的注意力，组成可以堆深的一层。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention plus question-guided attention, combined into a layer that can be stacked deep.

sections.text_zh:
2019 年，BERT 那套先预训练、再微调的办法被搬到了图文上（BERT 本身本馆还没有收）。ViLBERT 把 BERT 扩成两条流，图像走一条，文字走一条，两条流在协同注意力层里交换信息，四个下游任务都刷新了成绩。同年的 LXMERT 用了三个编码器，分别管物体之间的关系、语言和跨模态。

2021 年的 ALBEF 指出了一个被忽略的问题：图像的 token 和文字的 token 本来就没有对齐，硬塞进同一个编码器，它很难学会两者怎么交互。所以 ALBEF 分两步走，先用对比损失把图和字对齐，再用交叉注意力融合。
sections.text_en:
In 2019 the recipe from BERT, pretrain first and fine-tune later, was carried over to images and text. (BERT itself is not yet held here.) ViLBERT extended BERT into two streams, one for the image and one for the text, which trade information through co-attention layers. It set new results on four downstream tasks. LXMERT, from the same year, uses three encoders: one for relations between objects, one for language, one across the two.

ALBEF, in 2021, named a problem others had passed over. Image tokens and text tokens are not aligned to begin with, so an encoder handed both at once struggles to learn how they interact. ALBEF works in two steps: align images and text with a contrastive loss, then fuse them with cross-attention.

anchors.note_zh: 图像和文字各走一条流，在协同注意力层里碰头。
anchors.note_en: One stream for the image, one for the text, meeting in co-attention layers.

anchors.note_zh: 先对齐，再融合。
anchors.note_en: Align first, then fuse.

sections.text_zh:
大语言模型出来以后，把整个图文模型从头到尾训一遍变得太贵。通行的做法变成：图像编码器和语言模型都用现成的，参数冻住不动，只在中间搭一座小桥。这座桥的核心几乎都是交叉注意力。

Flamingo 在冻结的语言模型各层之间插进带门控的交叉注意力层（本馆已登记，还没有收进来）。BLIP-2 的 Q-Former 准备一小组可学习的查询向量，让它们通过交叉注意力去冻结的图像特征里取信息。它要训练的参数比 Flamingo80B 少 54 倍，零样本 VQAv2 的成绩反而高出 8.7%。Qwen-VL 更省：只用一层交叉注意力和一组可学习的查询，把长短不一的图像特征压成固定长度，再交给语言模型。

2024 年的 CogVLM 对这条路提出了异议。它认为只把图像特征映射到语言模型的输入端，融合得太浅。于是它在语言模型每一层的注意力和前馈部分里，各加了一套只处理图像 token 的可训练参数，叫作视觉专家。
sections.text_en:
Once large language models arrived, training a whole image-text model end to end became too expensive. The common practice changed: take an image encoder and a language model off the shelf, freeze both, and build a small bridge between them. The core of that bridge is almost always cross-attention.

Flamingo inserts gated cross-attention layers between the layers of a frozen language model. (It is registered here but not yet collected.) The Q-Former of BLIP-2 keeps a small set of learnable query vectors and sends them, through cross-attention, to fetch information from frozen image features. It trains 54 times fewer parameters than Flamingo80B and still scores 8.7% higher on zero-shot VQAv2. Qwen-VL is leaner still: a single cross-attention layer and one set of learnable queries compress image features of any length to a fixed length before they reach the language model.

CogVLM, in 2024, disagreed with this route. Mapping image features only into the input of the language model, it argued, fuses the two too shallowly. It added to the attention and feed-forward parts of every layer a set of trainable parameters that handle only image tokens, and called it the visual expert.

anchors.note_zh: 一小组可学习的查询，去冻结的图像特征里取语言模型用得上的信息。
anchors.note_en: A small set of learnable queries that fetch from frozen image features what a language model can use.

anchors.note_zh: 一层交叉注意力，把长短不一的图像特征压成固定长度。
anchors.note_en: One cross-attention layer that compresses image features of any length to a fixed length.

anchors.note_zh: 在语言模型每一层里，给图像 token 单独配一套参数。
anchors.note_en: A separate set of parameters for image tokens inside every layer of the language model.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力不再看格子，改看检测出来的一个个物体。
anchors.note_en: Attention stops looking at grid cells and looks at detected objects.

anchors.note_zh: 用双线性注意力，把图像区域和问题词两两之间的关系算进来。
anchors.note_en: Bilinear attention that accounts for every pairing of image region and question word.

anchors.note_zh: 自注意力加上问题引导的注意力，组成可以堆深的一层。
anchors.note_en: Self-attention plus question-guided attention, combined into a layer that can be stacked deep.

anchors.note_zh: 图像和文字各走一条流，在协同注意力层里碰头。
anchors.note_en: One stream for the image, one for the text, meeting in co-attention layers.

anchors.note_zh: 先对齐，再融合。
anchors.note_en: Align first, then fuse.

chapters.lede_zh: 自注意力让每个位置去看所有位置。序列长一倍，要算的位置对就多到四倍，显存也跟着涨。这一室收的都是绕开这个平方的办法。走到最后，它们绕回了第一室之前的东西：循环网络。
chapters.lede_en: Self-attention has every position look at every other. Double the sequence and the number of pairs quadruples, and memory rises with it. This room holds the ways around that square. At the end of the road they arrive back at something older than Room 1: the recurrent network.

sections.text_zh:
头一类办法最直接：不算全部的位置对，只算一部分。

Sparse Transformer 给注意力矩阵定了几种稀疏的图样，计算量降到 O(n√n)（本馆已登记，还没有收进来）。Longformer 让每个位置只看身边的一个滑动窗口，再按任务指定少数几个位置可以看全局，计算量随长度线性增长。BigBird 也是稀疏注意力，不过它多做了一件事：证明这样删过之后，模型仍然能逼近任意的序列函数，而且仍然图灵完备。作者还分析了那几个能看全局的 token 起了多大作用。
sections.text_en:
The first kind of fix is the most direct: do not compute every pair, only some.

Sparse Transformer laid out a few sparse patterns for the attention matrix and brought the cost down to O(n√n). (It is registered here but not yet collected.) Longformer lets each position look at a sliding window around itself, and lets a few positions chosen by the task look everywhere. The cost grows linearly with length. BigBird is sparse attention too, but it did one thing more: it proved that after this pruning the model can still approximate any sequence function and is still Turing complete. Its authors also analysed how much the few global tokens contribute.

anchors.note_zh: 身边一个滑动窗口，外加几个能看全局的位置。
anchors.note_en: A sliding window nearby, plus a few positions that can see everything.

anchors.note_zh: 证明了稀疏注意力没有丢掉表达能力。
anchors.note_en: Proved that sparse attention gives up no expressive power.

sections.text_zh:
第二类办法不删位置，改成近似地算整个注意力矩阵。

Reformer 用局部敏感哈希把相似的向量分到同一个桶里，只在桶内算注意力，计算量从 O(L²) 降到 O(L log L)。Linformer 发现自注意力矩阵可以用一个低秩矩阵来近似，时间和空间都降到 O(n)。Performer 用一组正交的随机特征去估计 softmax 注意力，并给出了估计无偏或接近无偏的保证。

这一类里最要紧的是 Katharopoulos 等人 2020 年的线性注意力。他们把 softmax 换成核特征映射的点积，再用矩阵乘法的结合律调换计算顺序，计算量降到 O(N)。然后他们多写了一句：这样的自回归 Transformer 可以一步一步迭代着算，它就是一个循环网络。这句话在这一室的最后一段会再出现。
sections.text_en:
The second kind of fix keeps every position and approximates the whole attention matrix.

Reformer uses locality-sensitive hashing to sort similar vectors into the same bucket and computes attention only within a bucket, which takes the cost from O(L²) to O(L log L). Linformer found that the self-attention matrix can be approximated by a low-rank one, bringing both time and memory to O(n). Performer estimates softmax attention with a set of orthogonal random features, and comes with a guarantee that the estimate is unbiased or nearly so.

The piece that matters most here is the linear attention of Katharopoulos and colleagues, from 2020. They replaced softmax with a dot product of kernel feature maps, then used the associativity of matrix multiplication to reorder the computation, reaching O(N). And they added one more remark: an autoregressive Transformer written this way can be computed step by step, which makes it a recurrent network. That remark returns in the last part of this room.

anchors.note_zh: 先用哈希分桶，只在桶里算注意力。
anchors.note_en: Hashes vectors into buckets and attends only within a bucket.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力矩阵是低秩的，那就按低秩来算。
anchors.note_en: The attention matrix is low-rank, so compute it that way.

anchors.note_zh: 调换一下乘法的顺序，注意力就成了线性的。论文的标题是「Transformer 是循环网络」。
anchors.note_en: Reorder the multiplication and attention becomes linear. The paper's title: Transformers are RNNs.

anchors.note_zh: 用随机特征估计 softmax 注意力，而且估得没有偏差。
anchors.note_en: Estimates softmax attention with random features, without bias.

sections.text_zh:
近似是有代价的。2022 年 cosFormer 的作者就指出，用核方法去近似 softmax 会带进误差，效果随任务起伏，和原版的 softmax 注意力比，掉点可以很明显。

所以后来有人换了思路：注意力照原样精确地算，只在硬件上省，少读写几次显存。那就是第八室的 FlashAttention。
sections.text_en:
Approximation has a price. The authors of cosFormer pointed out in 2022 that approximating softmax with kernel methods introduces error, that results swing from task to task, and that the drop against ordinary softmax attention can be large.

So a different idea followed: compute attention exactly as before, and save on the hardware instead by reading and writing GPU memory fewer times. That is FlashAttention, in Room 8.

sections.text_zh:
2023 年以后，「Transformer 是循环网络」这句话被重新拾了起来。

RetNet 推导出循环和注意力之间的关系：同一套机制，训练时可以并行，推理时可以一步一步循环着走，每一步的代价是常数。RWKV 用线性注意力把同一个模型写成 Transformer 和循环网络两种形式，一直训练到了 140 亿参数。

Mamba 干脆不要注意力层。它的作者认为，以前的线性注意力、门控卷积和状态空间模型在语言上比不过注意力，毛病出在同一处：它们没法根据内容决定记什么、忘什么。于是他们让状态空间模型的参数跟着输入变。GLA 给线性注意力加上了随数据变化的门。2025 年的 Gated DeltaNet 发现门和 delta 更新规则正好互补：门能很快地清掉记忆，delta 规则能准确地改写其中的一条。

本馆 2023 年以后的展品里，这类线性的循环层占了不少，也有把它们和注意力层搭着用的，例如 Jamba 就是 Transformer 层和 Mamba 层交替着堆。
sections.text_en:
After 2023 the remark that Transformers are RNNs was picked up again.

RetNet derived the connection between recurrence and attention: one mechanism that trains in parallel and, at inference, runs step by step at constant cost per step. RWKV uses linear attention to write the same model both as a Transformer and as a recurrent network, and was trained up to 14 billion parameters.

Mamba drops the attention layer altogether. Its authors argued that earlier linear attention, gated convolutions and state space models fall behind attention on language for one shared reason: they cannot decide what to keep and what to forget according to the content. So they made the parameters of a state space model depend on the input. GLA added data-dependent gates to linear attention. Gated DeltaNet, in 2025, found that gating and the delta update rule complement each other: a gate clears memory quickly, and the delta rule rewrites one entry precisely.

A good share of this museum's exhibits from 2023 onward are linear recurrent layers of this kind. Some models mix them with attention layers. Jamba, for one, alternates Transformer layers with Mamba layers.

anchors.note_zh: 训练时并行，推理时循环，每一步的代价不随长度增加。
anchors.note_en: Parallel in training, recurrent at inference, with a per-step cost that does not grow with length.

anchors.note_zh: 没有注意力层的语言模型：让状态空间模型按内容决定记什么。
anchors.note_en: A language model with no attention layer: a state space model that chooses what to remember by content.

anchors.note_zh: 门负责快速清空，delta 规则负责精确改写，两样放进同一层。
anchors.note_en: A gate to clear memory fast and a delta rule to rewrite it precisely, in one layer.

chapters.lede_zh: 第二室留下一笔账：自注意力分不出谁先谁后。Transformer 的办法是在输入上加一份绝对位置，第几个词就加第几号。这一室收的是此后几年里换掉这份位置表示的办法，以及模型训好之后，怎样让它读比训练时更长的东西。
chapters.lede_en: Room 2 left a debt unpaid: self-attention cannot tell first from last. The Transformer's answer was to add an absolute position to the input, number one for the first word and so on. This room holds the ways that answer was replaced in the years after, and the ways a trained model can be made to read more than it was trained on.

sections.text_zh:
2018 年 Shaw 等人换了个想法：要紧的不是一个词排第几，而是两个词隔多远。他们把这个相对距离直接写进了自注意力的计算里。在 WMT 2014 的英德和英法翻译上，这比绝对位置分别高出 1.3 和 0.3 BLEU。再把绝对位置一起加上，也没有更多的好处。

后面两件是对它的整理。T5 把做法简化到底：每一档相对距离只对应一个数，直接加在注意力分数上，距离越远分档越粗。DeBERTa 给每个词准备两个向量，一个表示内容，一个表示位置，词和词之间的注意力也拆开来，内容和位置各算各的。
sections.text_en:
In 2018 Shaw and colleagues changed the premise. What matters is not where a word sits in the sequence but how far apart two words are. They wrote that relative distance straight into the self-attention computation. On WMT 2014 English-German and English-French it beat absolute positions by 1.3 and 0.3 BLEU. Adding absolute positions on top brought no further gain.

The next two exhibits tidy the idea up. T5 simplifies it as far as it goes: each bucket of relative distance maps to a single number added to the attention score, and the buckets grow coarser with distance. DeBERTa gives each word two vectors, one for content and one for position, and splits the attention between words the same way, computing content and position separately.

anchors.note_zh: 不记第几个，只记隔多远。
anchors.note_en: Records how far apart, not which place.

anchors.note_zh: 每一档距离对应一个数，加在注意力分数上。
anchors.note_en: One number per distance bucket, added to the attention score.

anchors.note_zh: 内容一个向量，位置一个向量，分开算注意力。
anchors.note_en: One vector for content, one for position, attended to separately.

sections.text_zh:
旋转位置编码 RoPE 把绝对和相对接到了一起。它按每个词的绝对位置，把查询和键各自转过一个角度。两个向量再做点积的时候，结果只和它们转过的角度之差有关，也就是只和相对位置有关。

提出它的 RoFormer 论文 2021 年挂在 arXiv 上，本馆按 2024 年的期刊版登记，所以展签上写的是 2024。LLaMA 这一批大语言模型用的就是它。
sections.text_en:
Rotary position embedding, RoPE, joined the absolute and the relative. It rotates each query and each key by an angle set by the word's absolute position. When two such vectors meet in a dot product, the result depends only on the difference between their angles, which is to say only on relative position.

The RoFormer paper that introduced it appeared on arXiv in 2021. This museum catalogues it by the 2024 journal version, which is why the label says 2024. LLaMA and the large language models of its generation use it.

anchors.note_zh: 按绝对位置旋转向量，点积之后只剩相对位置。
anchors.note_en: Rotates vectors by absolute position. After the dot product only relative position remains.

sections.text_zh:
位置怎么表示，还管着另一件事：模型能读多长。

2022 年 ALiBi 的作者问得很直接：推理时来了一段比训练时更长的输入，怎么办？他们发现，只要换一种位置表示，模型就能往外推，而当时已有的几种办法推得都不怎么样。ALiBi 不往词向量上加任何位置信息，只在算注意力分数的时候，按查询和键隔得多远扣掉一点分，隔得越远扣得越多。一个 13 亿参数的模型在长度 1024 上训练，可以用到 2048。
sections.text_en:
How position is represented governs one more thing: how much a model can read.

The authors of ALiBi, in 2022, put the question directly. What happens when an input at inference is longer than anything seen in training? They found that changing the position method alone lets a model extrapolate, and that the methods in use at the time extrapolated poorly. ALiBi adds no position information to the word vectors. It only subtracts a little from each attention score according to the distance between query and key: the farther apart, the more. A 1.3-billion-parameter model trained at length 1024 can then be used at 2048.

anchors.note_zh: 不加位置向量，隔得越远，注意力分数扣得越多。训练时短，用的时候可以长。
anchors.note_en: No position vectors. The farther apart, the more the score is docked. Train short, use long.

sections.text_zh:
LLaMA 这类模型已经用 RoPE 训好了，下一个问题是怎样把它的窗口拉长。

2023 年的位置插值认为不能硬往外推：位置一超出训练时的范围，注意力分数会高得离谱，自注意力就全乱了。所以它反过来，把更长输入的位置编号等比例压回原来的窗口里。LLaMA 微调不到 1000 步，就能读到 32768 个 token。

后面两件接着改这个压缩的办法。YaRN 扩同样的窗口，用的 token 少 10 倍，训练步数少 2.5 倍。LongRoPE 发现各个维度、各段位置该压多少并不一样，按这个不均匀去压，再分两步放大，把窗口推到了 2048k 个 token。
sections.text_en:
Models such as LLaMA had already been trained with RoPE. The next question was how to stretch their window.

Position Interpolation, in 2023, argued against plain extrapolation: once positions leave the trained range, attention scores shoot far too high and self-attention falls apart. It went the other way and scaled the position indices of a longer input down into the original window. With fewer than 1000 steps of fine-tuning, LLaMA could read 32768 tokens.

The next two exhibits refine that scaling. YaRN extends the same window with ten times fewer tokens and 2.5 times fewer training steps. LongRoPE found that different dimensions and different stretches of positions should not be scaled by the same amount. Scaling them unevenly, then enlarging in two stages, pushed the window to 2048k tokens.

anchors.note_zh: 不往外推，把长输入的位置编号压回训练时的窗口里。
anchors.note_en: Does not extrapolate. Scales the positions of a long input back into the trained window.

anchors.note_zh: 同样是扩窗口，要的数据和训练步数都少得多。
anchors.note_en: Extends the window with far less data and far fewer training steps.

anchors.note_zh: 各维度压得不一样多，分两步把窗口扩到两百万 token。
anchors.note_en: Scales each dimension by a different amount and reaches two million tokens in two stages.

后面两件是对它的整理。T5 把做法简化到底：每一档相对距离只对应一个数，直接加在注意力分数上，距离越远分档越粗。DeBERTa 给每个词准备两个向量，一个表示内容，一个表示位置，词和词之间的注意力也拆开来，内容和位置各算各的。

旋转位置编码 RoPE 把绝对和相对接到了一起。它按每个词的绝对位置，把查询和键各自转过一个角度。两个向量再做点积的时候，结果只和它们转过的角度之差有关，也就是只和相对位置有关。

提出它的 RoFormer 论文 2021 年挂在 arXiv 上，本馆按 2024 年的期刊版登记，所以展签上写的是 2024。LLaMA 这一批大语言模型用的就是它。

位置怎么表示，还管着另一件事：模型能读多长。

2022 年 ALiBi 的作者问得很直接：推理时来了一段比训练时更长的输入，怎么办？他们发现，只要换一种位置表示，模型就能往外推，而当时已有的几种办法推得都不怎么样。ALiBi 不往词向量上加任何位置信息，只在算注意力分数的时候，按查询和键隔得多远扣掉一点分，隔得越远扣得越多。一个 13 亿参数的模型在长度 1024 上训练，可以用到 2048。

LLaMA 这类模型已经用 RoPE 训好了，下一个问题是怎样把它的窗口拉长。

2023 年的位置插值认为不能硬往外推：位置一超出训练时的范围，注意力分数会高得离谱，自注意力就全乱了。所以它反过来，把更长输入的位置编号等比例压回原来的窗口里。LLaMA 微调不到 1000 步，就能读到 32768 个 token。

后面两件接着改这个压缩的办法。YaRN 扩同样的窗口，用的 token 少 10 倍，训练步数少 2.5 倍。LongRoPE 发现各个维度、各段位置该压多少并不一样，按这个不均匀去压，再分两步放大，把窗口推到了 2048k 个 token。
chapters.body_en:
In 2018 Shaw and colleagues changed the premise. What matters is not where a word sits in the sequence but how far apart two words are. They wrote that relative distance straight into the self-attention computation. On WMT 2014 English-German and English-French it beat absolute positions by 1.3 and 0.3 BLEU. Adding absolute positions on top brought no further gain.

The next two exhibits tidy the idea up. T5 simplifies it as far as it goes: each bucket of relative distance maps to a single number added to the attention score, and the buckets grow coarser with distance. DeBERTa gives each word two vectors, one for content and one for position, and splits the attention between words the same way, computing content and position separately.

Rotary position embedding, RoPE, joined the absolute and the relative. It rotates each query and each key by an angle set by the word's absolute position. When two such vectors meet in a dot product, the result depends only on the difference between their angles, which is to say only on relative position.

The RoFormer paper that introduced it appeared on arXiv in 2021. This museum catalogues it by the 2024 journal version, which is why the label says 2024. LLaMA and the large language models of its generation use it.

How position is represented governs one more thing: how much a model can read.

The authors of ALiBi, in 2022, put the question directly. What happens when an input at inference is longer than anything seen in training? They found that changing the position method alone lets a model extrapolate, and that the methods in use at the time extrapolated poorly. ALiBi adds no position information to the word vectors. It only subtracts a little from each attention score according to the distance between query and key: the farther apart, the more. A 1.3-billion-parameter model trained at length 1024 can then be used at 2048.

Models such as LLaMA had already been trained with RoPE. The next question was how to stretch their window.

Position Interpolation, in 2023, argued against plain extrapolation: once positions leave the trained range, attention scores shoot far too high and self-attention falls apart. It went the other way and scaled the position indices of a longer input down into the original window. With fewer than 1000 steps of fine-tuning, LLaMA could read 32768 tokens.

The next two exhibits refine that scaling. YaRN extends the same window with ten times fewer tokens and 2.5 times fewer training steps. LongRoPE found that different dimensions and different stretches of positions should not be scaled by the same amount. Scaling them unevenly, then enlarging in two stages, pushed the window to 2048k tokens.

chapters.lede_zh: 模型大到一定程度，难处就从训练挪到了使用。每往外写一个词，都要把前面所有词的键和值从显存里再读一遍。这一室的展品大多在省这一笔：少存一点，少读几次，少看几个位置。
chapters.lede_en: Past a certain size, the hard part of a model moves from training it to running it. For each word it writes, the keys and values of every earlier word must be read from GPU memory again. Most exhibits in this room save on that bill: store less, read fewer times, look at fewer positions.

sections.text_zh:
Shazeer 在 2019 年就把这个问题讲清楚了。训练的时候整条序列可以一起算，一个词一个词往外写的时候不行：每一步都要把很大的键张量和值张量重新加载一遍，速度卡在显存的带宽上。他提出多查询注意力，让所有的头共用同一组键和值，解码快了很多，质量只掉一点点。

下文要等到四年以后。2023 年的 GQA 取了个中间值：键值头不止一组，但比查询头少。作者还给了一个改造旧模型的办法，只花原先预训练 5% 的算力，就能把一个训好的多头模型改成这种结构。
sections.text_en:
Shazeer set the problem out clearly in 2019. In training, a whole sequence is computed together. Writing one word at a time is different: each step reloads the large key and value tensors, and speed is capped by memory bandwidth. He proposed multi-query attention, in which all heads share one set of keys and values. Decoding became much faster and quality fell only slightly.

The follow-up came four years later. GQA, in 2023, took a middle value: more than one group of key-value heads, but fewer than the query heads. Its authors also gave a recipe for converting an existing model. With 5% of the original pretraining compute, a trained multi-head checkpoint can be turned into this form.

anchors.note_zh: 所有的头共用一组键和值，解码时少搬很多数据。
anchors.note_en: All heads share one set of keys and values, so decoding moves far less data.

anchors.note_zh: 键值头分成几组，介于「每头一组」和「全部共用」之间。
anchors.note_en: Key-value heads in a few groups: between one per head and one for all.

sections.text_zh:
FlashAttention 盯上的是另一种浪费。作者说，第六室那些近似的办法，纸面上的计算量是降了，放到机器上却常常快不起来。他们认为大家漏算了一项：数据在 GPU 的大块显存和芯片上的小块高速缓存之间来回读写，这才是真正花时间的地方。FlashAttention 把注意力切成小块来算，结果一位不差，读写的次数少了很多。

PagedAttention 管的是键值缓存怎么放。它借了操作系统给内存分页的老办法，把缓存切成一页一页的，按需分配，零碎的空位和重复的副本就少了。
sections.text_en:
FlashAttention went after a different kind of waste. Its authors noted that the approximations of Room 6 lower the cost on paper but often bring no speed-up on a real machine. What had been left out of the accounting, they argued, is the traffic between the GPU's large main memory and its small, fast on-chip memory. That traffic is where the time goes. FlashAttention computes attention in small tiles. The result is exact, and the reads and writes are far fewer.

PagedAttention deals with where the key-value cache is kept. It borrows paging, the old operating-system method for managing memory: the cache is cut into pages and handed out on demand, which leaves fewer gaps and fewer duplicate copies.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力照原样精确地算，只是切成小块，少读写几次显存。
anchors.note_en: Exact attention, computed in tiles so that GPU memory is read and written fewer times.

anchors.note_zh: 像操作系统管内存那样，一页一页地管键值缓存。
anchors.note_en: Manages the key-value cache in pages, the way an operating system manages memory.

sections.text_zh:
缓存本身也可以删、可以压。

H2O 发现，注意力分数的大头是由少数几个 token 贡献的，那么缓存里只留这几个和最近的一段就够了。StreamingLLM 试了更简单的做法，只留最近的一个窗口，结果文本一超过缓存的长度，模型就不行了。作者接着发现，只要把最开头那几个 token 的键和值留着，效果基本能找回来。他们管这几个 token 叫注意力汇点：它们自己未必有什么意思，却吸走了很高的注意力分数。

DeepSeek-V2 的多头潜在注意力是压而不是删，把键和值一起压进一个低维的潜在向量，键值缓存比 DeepSeek 67B 少用 93.3%。2025 年的 NSA 把两样合在一起，粗的一层压缩 token，细的一层挑选 token。以前的稀疏注意力大多是训练完了再套上去的，NSA 从训练的时候就这么算，设计时也照顾了硬件。
sections.text_en:
The cache itself can be trimmed, and it can be compressed.

H2O found that a few tokens contribute most of the attention score, so the cache need keep only those and the most recent stretch. StreamingLLM tried something simpler, keeping only a recent window, and the model broke down as soon as the text outgrew the cache. Its authors then found that keeping the keys and values of the first few tokens recovers most of what was lost. They named those tokens attention sinks: they may mean little in themselves, yet they draw very high attention scores.

Multi-head latent attention, in DeepSeek-V2, compresses instead of trimming. It packs keys and values together into a low-dimensional latent vector and uses 93.3% less key-value cache than DeepSeek 67B. NSA, in 2025, combines the two approaches: a coarse layer that compresses tokens and a fine layer that selects them. Earlier sparse attention was mostly applied after training. NSA computes this way from training onward, and was designed with the hardware in mind.

anchors.note_zh: 留住开头几个 token 和最近的一段，模型就能一直往下读。
anchors.note_en: Keep the first few tokens and the most recent stretch, and the model can keep reading indefinitely.

anchors.note_zh: 把键和值压进一个潜在向量，缓存小了九成多。
anchors.note_en: Packs keys and values into a latent vector. The cache shrinks by more than nine tenths.

anchors.note_zh: 稀疏注意力从训练时就用上：粗处压缩，细处挑选。
anchors.note_en: Sparse attention used from training onward: compress coarsely, select finely.

sections.text_zh:
还有人回过头去改 softmax 注意力本身。

Diff Transformer 认为，Transformer 把太多注意力分给了不相干的上下文。它算两张 softmax 注意力图，拿一张减另一张，两边共有的噪声就抵消了。2025 年的门控注意力做得更小：在注意力算完之后，给每个头加一个 sigmoid 门。作者认为它起作用有两个原因，门让注意力多了一层非线性，门的取值本身又很稀疏。他们还报告说，上面讲的注意力汇点，在加了门之后减轻了。

导览到这里结束。从 2014 年算起，这十几年里的展品，绝大多数改的都是第一室里的那三步：打分，加权，求和。
sections.text_en:
Others went back to softmax attention itself.

Diff Transformer argued that a Transformer spends too much attention on irrelevant context. It computes two softmax attention maps and subtracts one from the other, so the noise they share cancels out. Gated Attention, in 2025, makes a smaller change: after attention is computed, each head gets a sigmoid gate. Its authors give two reasons it works. The gate adds a non-linearity to attention, and the gate values are themselves sparse. They also report that the attention sinks described above grow weaker once the gate is added.

The tour ends here. Nearly every exhibit from 2014 to now changes the same three steps from Room 1: score, weight, sum.

anchors.note_zh: 两张注意力图相减，抵消掉分给无关内容的那部分。
anchors.note_en: Subtracts one attention map from another to cancel what was spent on irrelevant content.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力之后给每个头加一个门。作者说注意力汇点因此减轻了。
anchors.note_en: A gate on each head after attention. The authors report weaker attention sinks.
